bosch/tps110.name: Parking Lot Sensor
bosch/tps110.description: The BOSCH wireless smart parking sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device that uses a magnetometer and radar which are two independent sensors for parking space occupancy. It enables active parking lot management features, such as search, navigation, and reservation. In addition to that, the BOSCH parking lot sensor has a GPS receiver and a temperature sensor.

comtac/lpn-td1.name: LPN TD-1 Tracker
comtac/lpn-td1.description: The Comtac LPN TD-1 is a LoRaWAN® indoor/outdoor positioning tracker that uses GPS and WiFi or a combination of both to determine the location. Ideal for tracking devices, machines, tools, vehicles, persons, and many more.

comtac/lpn-km.name: LPN KM - Short-circuit monitor
comtac/lpn-km.description: The Comtac LPN KM Short Circuit monitor detects short-circuit and ground fault. The integrated battery-supported power supply and the easy integration into private or public LoRaWAN® networks allow a cost-effective upgrade of stations for faster fault localization and resupply.

comtac/lpn-cm4.name: LPN CM-4 Sensor - Temperature & Humidity Sensor
comtac/lpn-cm4.description: The comtac LPN CM-4 SENSOR has a built-in temperature sensor and a humidity sensor that records temperature and moisture at programmable intervals. The collected data is sent over the LoRaWAN® network for further processing.

cotx/cotxpetfon.name: Petfon LoRa Tracker
cotx/cotxpetfon.description: With the LoRaWAN protocol, you can track anything you want, such as pets, children, cars, etc.

dezem/harvy-lr-36.name: HarvyLR 36 - Current Sensor
dezem/harvy-lr-36.description: Self-powered LoRaWAN IoT sensor for AC and DC currents

dezem/harvy-lr-360.name: HarvyLR 360 - Current Sensor
dezem/harvy-lr-360.description: Self-powered LoRaWAN IoT sensor for AC and DC currents

digital-matter/oyster.name: Oyster - Asset Tracking
digital-matter/oyster.description: The Digital Matter Oyster is an ultra-rugged and long-life battery-powered GPS tracking device for asset tracking and management on LoRaWAN® networks that is packed with a GPS+GLONASS sensor and a 3-axis accelerometer. The IP67 rated housing ensures the device can withstand fine dust, high-pressure spray, submersion for 30 minutes in 1m of water, and extreme temperatures.

dingtek/df701.name: DF701 - Indoor Waste Bin Laser Level Sensor
dingtek/df701.description: The CNDingtek df701 is a laser level sensor for indoor waste bins. The measured data is reported to a LoRaWAN® network that notifies garbage collecting authorities to collect and empty the bins.

dingtek/df702.name: DF702 - Waste Bin Level Sensor
dingtek/df702.description: The CNDingtek DF702 is a waste bin sensor that consists of a level sensor, fire sensor, and accelerometer. The measured data is reported to a LoRaWAN® network that notifies garbage collecting authorities to collect and empty the bins.

dingtek/df703.name: DF703 - Ultrasonic Waste Bin Level Sensor
dingtek/df703.description: The CNDingtek df703 is an ultrasonic level waste bin sensor that consists of a level sensor, fire sensor, and accelerometer. The measured data is reported to a LoRaWAN® network that notifies garbage collecting authorities to collect and empty the bins.

dingtek/df200.name: DF200 - Soap Dispenser Level Sensor
dingtek/df200.description: The CNDingtek df200 is soap dispenser level sensor, which detect the liquid level in the dispenser.

dingtek/df400.name: DF400 - Tissue Dispenser Level Sensor
dingtek/df400.description: The CNDingtek df400 is tissue dispenser level sensor, which detect the paper in the dispenser.

dingtek/df530.name: DF530 - Tank Level Sensor
dingtek/df530.description: lpg tank level sensor, detect liquid level in tank.

dingtek/df555.name: DF555 - Ultrasonic Tank Level Sensor
dingtek/df555.description: The CNDingtek df555 is an ultrasonic level for kinds tank, which is installed on top of the tank.

dingtek/df556.name: DF556 - Pressure Tank Level Sensor
dingtek/df556.description: The CNDingtek df556 is a pressure type level for kinds tank, which is installed on top of the tank.

dingtek/dc410.name: DC410 - Manhole Sensor
dingtek/dc410.description: The CNDingtek DC410 is a smart manhole sensor that integrates a liquid/solid level sensor and a movement sensor. Suitable for measuring water and sewage levels in wells and manholes. The data is sent to a LoRaWAN network, then the application server for further processing.

dingtek/dc413.name: DC413 - Manhole Sensor
dingtek/dc413.description: The CNDingtek dc413 is a smart manhole sensor that integrates a liquid/solid level sensor and a movement sensor. Suitable for measuring water and sewage levels in wells and manholes. The data is sent to a LoRaWAN network, then the application server for further processing.

dingtek/dc500.name: DC500 - People Counter
dingtek/dc500.description: The CNDingtek dc500 is a pir people counter, which calculate the people number.

dingtek/dc510.name: DC510 - People Counter
dingtek/dc510.description: The CNDingtek dc510 is a pir people counter for indoor using, which calculate the people number.

dingtek/dc520.name: DC520 - People Counter
dingtek/dc520.description: The CNDingtek dc520 is a microwave radar bidirection people counter for indoor using, which calculate the people number for in/out respectively.

dingtek/dc600.name: DC600 - Water Leakage Sensor
dingtek/dc600.description: The CNDingtek dc600 is water leakage sensor with up to 4 channels.

dingtek/do200.name: DO200 - Parking Occupancy Sensor
dingtek/do200.description: The CNDingtek do200 is parking occupation sensor with combination of ultrasonic and magnetic detection , fire sensor, and accelerometer.

dingtek/do201.name: DO201 - Parking Occupancy Sensor
dingtek/do201.description: The CNDingtek do201 is parking occupancy sensor with combination of ultrasonic and magnetic detection, temperature and humidity measurement.

dingtek/do202.name: DO202 - Parking Occupancy Sensor
dingtek/do202.description: The CNDingtek do202 is parking occupancy sensor with combination of microwave radar and magnetic detection, temperature and humidity measurement.

dingtek/dt311.name: DT311 - Temperature & Humidity Sensor
dingtek/dt311.description: The CNDingtek dt311 is temperature and humidity sensor for indoor using.

dnt/dnt-lw-ats.name: LoRaWAN® Asset Tracker Solar
dnt/dnt-lw-ats.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Asset Tracker Solar (dnt-lw-ats) is a reliable and compact GNSS tracker with a water- and dust proof housing according to IP44. Through the built-in solar cell, self-sufficient operation is possible. The position determination can be done cyclically or motion-based. In addition, there are many configuration options through LoRaWAN® downlinks, like the motion sensitivity or the positioning interval. The average sleep mode current is below 10 µA.

dnt/dnt-lw-etrv.name: LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat
dnt/dnt-lw-etrv.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat (dnt-lw-eTRV) enables remote control of the room temperature. It features three customizable heating profiles with up to ten switching times per day. Because of very low energy consumption of only 3.8 uA, a battery life up to 5 years can be archived.

dnt/dnt-lw-dis.name: LoRaWAN® distance sensor 1
dnt/dnt-lw-dis.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Distance Sensor 1 (dnt-lw-dis) is a robust LoRaWAN® device for measuring distances outdoors. With its measuring range of 4 to 360 cm, the easy-to-install housing and various configuration options it can be used for a wide range of applications.

dnt/dnt-lw-etrv-c.name: LoRaWAN® Radiator Thermostat Controllable
dnt/dnt-lw-etrv-c.description: The dnt® LoRaWAN® Radiator thermostat Controllable (dnt-lw-eTRV-C) enables two ways to adjust the room temperature: directly on the device with the integrated buttons or remote control via Downlinks. It features an always-on e-paper display to show the current temperature settings, three customizable heating profiles with up to ten switching times per day, a window open detection to automatically reduce temperature and the possibility to perform a dynamic adaptive adjustment of the radiator. Because of very low energy consumption, a battery life up to 3 years can be archived.

dnt/dnt-lw-wth.name: LoRaWAN® Wall Thermostat
dnt/dnt-lw-wth.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Wall Thermostat (dnt-lw-wth) controls the heating or air conditioning of the room. It measures the room temperature and humidity and shows it on the integrated Display. For automatic adjustment of the room temperature, the user can configure three profiles with each up to ten temperature changes a day. Other features are the window-open detection, a holiday mode, an energy-saving mode and various configuration options through LoRaWAN downlinks. Through our low power design, the device consumes only 45 uA in default mode, which results in a battery lifetime of up to 5 years.

dnt/dnt-lw-esi.name: LoRaWAN® energy sensor interface
dnt/dnt-lw-esi.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® energy sensor intefrace (dnt-lw-esi) is a battery powered device to integrate smart meters into the LoRaWAN® network. It can collect data from electricity and gas meters with different sensors.

dnt/dnt-lw-wsci.name: LoRaWAN® window sensor and contact interface
dnt/dnt-lw-wsci.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® window sensor and contact interface can detect the state of a window of a door (open/closed) via the integrated magnetometer or the contact interface. Besides an external reed contact, it is also possible to attach a glas-break sensor to the contact interface to use the device in security context.

dnt/dnt-lw-bsm.name: LoRaWAN® Switch Actuator and Meter for brand switches
dnt/dnt-lw-bsm.description: The dnt LoRaWAN® Switch Actuator and Meter for brand switches is the ideal solution for intelligent control of lights and other electrical loads in public buildings such as schools, industrial plants, government facilities, hotels, or offices. It can be deployed within existing infrastructure and offers remote control via downlinks or directly on the device using the mounted switch plate.

ellenex/pls2-l-v6.name: PLS2-L-V6- Level Transmitter
ellenex/pls2-l-v6.description: LoRaWAN Operated Low Power Level Transmitter for Liquid Media

elspina/em-elst01.name: EM-ELST01
elspina/em-elst01.description: Device to capture state changes through its accelerometer and switch sensor.

elv/elv-bm-trx1.name: LoRIS-BM-TRX1 - Experimental platform for LoRaWAN
elv/elv-bm-trx1.description: The modular system of ELV Elektronik AG makes it possible to carry out LoRaWAN experiments. The basis is the ELV LoRaWAN Base, on which various application modules and power modules equipped with sensors can be attached. The integrated antenna and compact form factor allow experiments to be carried out flexibly. The required firmware is provided by ELV, but the programming adapter can also be used to execute your own code.

elv/elv-lw-esi.name: LoRaWAN® Energy Sensing Interface
elv/elv-lw-esi.description: The ELV LoRaWAN® Energy Meter Sensor Interface ELV-LW-ESI kit is an interface module that, in conjunction with a radio module (included in the kit), records the energy consumption directly on the electricity or gas meter and sends the determined data via LoRaWAN®. The flexible meter reading can be implemented conveniently  for many of the common electricity and gas consumption meters. Various sensors can be used to read out the meters, e.g. electricity meters with IEC or LED interface, Ferraris or gas meters. The sensors are available separately and can therefore be individually adapted to the application. The ELV-LW-ESI kit is continuously supplied via a USB-C socket and therefore does not require a battery change.

elv/elv-lw-gps1.name: LoRaWAN® GPS Tracker 1
elv/elv-lw-gps1.description: The ELV LoRaWAN® GPS Tracker 1 is the second GNSS-based product in the LoRaWAN® family. Unlike the ELV track from our modular system, the ELV-LW-GPS1 is an optimized design without module character. The GPS tracker uses a GNSS module for position determination, the corresponding data is sent via the LoRaWAN® network. An integrated accelerometer is used to use motion or standstill as a trigger for positioning. Furthermore, a contact interface is installed, which can also trigger a determination of the current position via an external trigger. The device can be supplied in a wide voltage range of 5 to 40 V. Thanks to its compactness, the wide input voltage range and the various modes for position determination, the tracker can be used in many applications.

elv/elv-lw-gps2.name: LoRaWAN® GPS Tracker 2
elv/elv-lw-gps2.description: The ELV LoRaWAN® GPS Tracker 2 is a low power battery powerd device that can track the position in tree modes: cyclic, motion-detection or contact interface. Common use cases are any kind of outdoor tracking like cycling or hiking or object tracking in agriculture

elv/elv-lw-mob.name: Motion Button for LoRaWAN®
elv/elv-lw-mob.description: Compact LoRaWAN® battery powered radio remote control with acceleration and tilt detection from ELV

elv/elv-lw-omo.name: Outdoor Motion Sensor for LoRaWAN®
elv/elv-lw-omo.description: The ELV-LW-OMO is a device to track acceleration, vibration or realtive position changes of an outdoor asset. Fields of application are e.g. the monitoring of garbage cans or the detection of activity at a bird house

elv/elv-lw-int1.name: LoRaWAN® Interface 1
elv/elv-lw-int1.description: Interface to connect UART and I2C sensors to LoRaWAN® Network

elv/elv-lw-swd.name: LoRaWAN® water sensor
elv/elv-lw-swd.description: LoRaWAN® water sensor to detect moisture and prevent resulting damage

elv/elv-lw-oc8.name: LoRaWAN® Module Board Open Collector 8fold
elv/elv-lw-oc8.description: The ELV LoRaWAN® Module Board Open Collector 8fold (ELV-LW-OC8) is a powerful LoRaWAN® Class C actor with 8 open collector output channels. These outputs can either be controlled by the corresponding input channels or via downlink to enable various controlling options.

enginko/mcf-lw06davk.name: MCF-LW06DAVK - Weather Station
enginko/mcf-lw06davk.description: The enginko MCF-LW06DAVK is equipped with a wide range of sensors such as temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, rainfall, wind speed and direction, solar radiation, PM1, PM2.5, and PM10. Suitable for smart agriculture, industry, smart city, waste station control, etc.

enginko/mcf-lw06davpk.name: MCF-LW06DAVPK - Weather Station
enginko/mcf-lw06davpk.description: The enginko MCF-LW06DAVPK integrates a LoRaWAN® communication system in a Davis Instruments Vantage Pro2 Weather Station. The station is equipped with a wide range of sensors such as temperature, humidity, pressure, rainfall, dew point, wind speed, wind direction, solar radiation, PM1, PM2.5, and PM10.

enginko/mcf-lw12co2.name: MCF-LW12CO2 - Indoor Environmental Sensor
enginko/mcf-lw12co2.description: The enginko MCF-LW12CO2 LoRaWAN® indoor environmental sensor equipped with temperature, humidity, pressure, light intensity, air quality (expressed as IAQ or bVOC value), and CO2 sensors and sends collected data over the LoRaWAN® network. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as building automation, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, security, healthcare, and many more use cases.

enginko/mcf-lw12co2e.name: MCF-LW12CO2E - Indoor Environmental sensor
enginko/mcf-lw12co2e.description: The MCF-LW12CO2E is a battery powered sensor for indoor applications that reads temperature, relative humidity, pressure, ambient light, IAQ air quality index and CO2. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as home buildings, air quality monitoring and energy saving applications.

enginko/mcf-lw12met.name: MCF-LW12MET - Energy Meter With I/O
enginko/mcf-lw12met.description: The enginko MCF-LW12MET is a LoRaWAN® Mono-Phase Energy Meter with I/O that can be used for monitoring and checking the power of electronic devices, and can remotely switch devices on/off and read the state of digital input.

enginko/mcf-lw12plg.name: MCF-LW12PLG - Smart Plug
enginko/mcf-lw12plg.description: The enginko MCF-LW12PLG is a LoRaWAN® Energy Meter plug with On/Off capability that supports metering and switching of a 230Vac – 16 Amp Load (active, reactive, and apparent energy; Class 0.2).

enginko/mcf-lw12ter.name: MCF-LW12TER - Indoor Environmental Sensor
enginko/mcf-lw12ter.description: The mfc88 MCF-LW12TER is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, and pressure sensor for monitoring indoor environments. The collected data is transmitted over the LoRaWAN network. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as building automation, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, security, healthcare, and many more use cases.

enginko/mcf-lw12terwp.name: MCF-LW12TERWP - Outdoor Environmental Sensor
enginko/mcf-lw12terwp.description: The mfc88 MCF-LW12TERWP is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, and pressure sensor for monitoring outdoor environments. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as weather stations, urban monitoring, air quality, industrial, environmental, or farming projects.

enginko/mcf-lw12terpm.name: MCF-LW12TERPM - Outdoor Environmental Sensor
enginko/mcf-lw12terpm.description: The enginko MCF-LW12TERPM is an outdoor PM and environmental sensor that consists of temperature, humidity, pressure, and PM (PM1, PM2.5, PM10) sensors. It sends collected data over the LoRaWAN® network. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as weather stations, urban monitoring, air quality, industrial, environmental, or farming projects.

enginko/mcf-lw12voc.name: MCF-LW12VOC - Indoor Environmental Sensor
enginko/mcf-lw12voc.description: The mfc88 MCF-LW12VOC is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, pressure sensor, light intensity sensor, and an air quality sensor for monitoring indoor environments. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as building automation, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, security, healthcare, and many more use cases.

enginko/mcf-lw13io.name: MCF-LW13IO - Wireless Actuator
enginko/mcf-lw13io.description: The enginko MCF-LW13IO is a wireless actuator that consists of an Opto-isolated input and a relay output. The device transmits the status of its input and controls the output through the LoRaWAN® network. Can be used for industrial process control and home automation, water treatment, agriculture irrigation, and similar applications.

enginko/mcf-lw13mio.name: MCF-LW13MIO - Multi I/O Module
enginko/mcf-lw13mio.description: The enginko MCF-LW13MIO is a LoRaWAN® multi I/O module that transmits the state of its 16 inputs and controls 8 outputs through the LoRaWAN® network. All these inputs and outputs are galvanically isolated. It can be used for industrial process control, home automation, water treatment, agriculture irrigation, and similar applications.

enginko/mcf-lwws00.description: The enginko MCF-LWWS00 integrates a LoRaWAN® communication system in a Davis Instruments Vantage Pro2 Weather Station. enginko/egk-lw22plg.name: EGK-LW22PLG - Smart Plug
enginko/egk-lw22plg.description: The enginko EGK-LW22PLG is a LoRaWAN® Energy Meter plug with On/Off capability that supports metering and switching of a 230Vac – 16 Amp Load (active, reactive, and apparent energy; Class 0.2).

enginko/egk-lw20w00.name: EGK-LW20W00 - Waste Level Sensor
enginko/egk-lw20w00.description: The enginko EGK-LW20W00 is a LoRaWAN® is a battery powered sensor intended for waste level measurement up to 1.5 meters.

enginko/egk-lw20l00.name: EGK-LW20L00 - Level Sensor
enginko/egk-lw20l00.description: The enginko EGK-LW20L00 is a LoRaWAN® is a battery powered sensor intended for level measurement up to 7 meters.

enless-wireless/tx-pulse-600.name: 600-036 - Pulse Meter Sensor
enless-wireless/tx-pulse-600.description: The Enless Wireless Tx Pulse 600-036 consists of a pulse sensor that is compatible with pulse meters with a dry contact interface or an open collector inlet. It transmits pulse counts over the LoRaWAN® network. Tx Pulse 600-036 will quickly and economically transform your conventional gas meter into a smart meter.

enless-wireless/tx-trh-amb-600-021.name: 600-021 - Ambient Temperature and Humidity sensor
enless-wireless/tx-trh-amb-600-021.description: Specifically designed for indoor applications in an ambient environment, the Enless Wireless LoRaWAN humidity and temperature transmitter allows you to monitor occupant comfort levels, thanks to its integrated sensors of temperature and humidity (data °C - %rH)) and save energy by monitoring HVAC systems - Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning - in situ.

enless-wireless/tx-amb-600-023.name: 600-023 - Ambient VOC,CO2,Temperature and Humidity sensor
enless-wireless/tx-amb-600-023.description: Specifically designed for indoor applications in an ambient environment, the Enless Wireless LoRaWAN CO2, VOC, humidity and temperature transmitter allows you to monitor occupant comfort levels, thanks to its integrated sensors of CO2 (ppm), VOC (ppb), temperature (°C) and humidity (%rH). The CO2 and the VOC contents are the main indicators of the air quality breathed by users.

enless-wireless/tx-temp-600-031.name: 600-031 - Rugged Temperature Sensor
enless-wireless/tx-temp-600-031.description: Many sectors (building - smart building - industry - agriculture...) integrate temperature monitoring activities into their processes. This Enless Wireless LoRaWAN “hardened” (IP65) transmitter with integrated temperature sensor is used for temperature monitoring (°C) for different applications in outdoor environments and/or in areas subject to extreme conditions.

enless-wireless/tx-temp-cont1-600-032.name: 600-032 - Temperature sensor with External contact probe (PT1000)
enless-wireless/tx-temp-cont1-600-032.description: This Enless Wireless LoRaWAN IP65 transmitter with external temperature contact probe allows you to measure temperatures (°C) in a remote manner, on contact with surfaces.The robustness of our transmitter – IP 65 housing – and its high environmental tolerance (probe temperature range -180°C / +250°C) allow it to withstand any type of “outdoor” environment, sometimes under extreme conditionse monitoring activities into their processes. This Enless Wireless LoRaWAN “hardened” (IP65) transmitter with integrated temperature sensor is used for temperature monitoring (°C) for different applications in outdoor environments and/or in areas subject to extreme conditions.

enless-wireless/tx-temp-cont2-600-034.name: 600-034 - Temperature and Humidity sensor - External probe
enless-wireless/tx-temp-cont2-600-034.description: This Enless Wireless LoRaWAN IP65 transmitter with external temperature and humidity probe allows you to measure temperatures and humidity (°C & %rH data) in a remote manner.The robustness of our transmitter - IP 65 housing - and its high environmental tolerance (probe temperature range - 40°C / +125°C) allow it to withstand any type of “outdoor” environment, sometimes under extreme conditions.

enless-wireless/tx-pulse-atex-600-037.name: 600-037 - Pulse Meter sensor - ATEX Approved(Gas)
enless-wireless/tx-pulse-atex-600-037.description: This LoRaWAN pulse transmitter has been specially designed for pulse counting applications on gas meters with a dry contact interface or an open collector inlet.ATEX approved – Explosives Atmospheres – Zone 0, this transmitter allows the remote reading of the data from the gas meter to which it is connected without any manual intervention. In other words, this transmitter will quickly and economically transform your conventional gas meter into a smart meter.

enless-wireless/tx-temp-cont2-600-232.name: 600-232 - Temperature Sensor-2 External contact probes (PT1000)
enless-wireless/tx-temp-cont2-600-232.description: This Enless Wireless LoRaWAN IP65 transmitter with two external temperature contact probes allows you to measure two temperature points (°C) simultaneously in a remote manner, on contact with surfaces.The robustness of our transmitter – IP 65 housing – and its high environmental tolerance (probe temperature range - 180°C / +250°C) allow it to withstand any type of “outdoor” environment, sometimes under extreme conditions.

enless-wireless/tx-analog-600-035.name: 600-035 - Analog sensor with 4/20mA interface
enless-wireless/tx-analog-600-035.description: This LoRa / LoRaWAN 4/20mA analogue radio transmitter is specifically designed for industrial applications (construction industry - water management - rail industry,etc.).Self-powered, it connects to all types of analogue probes with 4/20mA interface and reassemble the signal.This transmitter can meet all types of applications including pressure, flow, fluid levels (water, fuel oil, gas,etc.) / gauges (ultrasonic probes), etc.The robustness of our LoRaWAN transmitter – IP 65 enclosure – and its high environmental tolerance (-20°C / +55°C) allow it to withstand any type of environment.

enless-wireless/tx-pulse-led-600-038.name: 600-038 - Pulse sensor for Electric Meter - LED optical reader
enless-wireless/tx-pulse-led-600-038.description: This LoRaWAN pulse meter transmitter works by reading and transcribing pulsed LED flashes and is therefore compatible with electric meters with light diodes.This radio transmitter allows the remote reading of the electric consumption data from the meter to which it is connected without any manual intervention. In other words, this transmitter will quickly and economically transform your electric meter into a smart meter. hanks to its LED optical reading head, the connection to the meter is simplified and requires only a few seconds.

enless-wireless/tx-contact-600-039.name: 600-039 - Digital Input sensor (status report ON/OFF)
enless-wireless/tx-contact-600-039.description: This LoRaWAN contact/status change transmitter is specifically designed for smart building, security and industrial applications.It meets all types of ON/OFF status change monitoring needs thanks to its two dry-contact inputs (binary output signal).

ezurio/rs1xx-temp-rh-sensor.description: The Ezurio Sentrius™ RS1xx Temp/-RH has a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, and an external open/closed detection sensor making it a perfect fit for cold chain applications. It uses LoRaWAN® and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for data communication. The robust IP65 sensor enclosure allows it to be used in harsh environments.

ezurio/rs1xx-ext-temp-1w-sensor.name: Sentrius RS1xx Ext Temp 1W Sensor
ezurio/rs1xx-ext-temp-1w-sensor.description: The Ezurio Sentrius™ RS1xx Temp/-RH has an external temperature sensor probe and humidity sensor making it a perfect fit for industrial applications. ezurio/rs1xx-ext-multi-sensor.name: Sentrius RS1xx Multi Sensor
ezurio/rs1xx-ext-multi-sensor.description: The Ezurio Sentrius RS1xx Multi Sensor is a battery-powered, long-range sensor platform leveraging the benefits of LoRaWAN® and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connectivity. ezurio/rs1xx-ext-temp-rtd-sensor.description: The Ezurio Sentrius™ RS1xx Ext Temp RTD has an external temperature sensor probe making it a perfect fit for monitoring low and slow cooking temps mounted inside a smoker. inbiot/mini-lora.description: MICA Mini is a compact indoor air quality sensor with LoRaWAN, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT/LTE-M and Sigfox connectivity, measuring temperature, relative humidity and CO₂, and providing thermohygrometric comfort, ventilation efficiency and resistance to mold growth indicators, with optional noise monitoring and integration with building management systems via Modbus and BACnet.

inbiot/mica-lora.name: MICA - Indoor Air Quality Sensor
inbiot/mica-lora.description: MICA is a smart indoor air quality monitor supporting LoRaWAN, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT/LTE-M and Sigfox connectivity that measures temperature, relative humidity, CO₂, TVOC, PM2.5 and PM10, and delivers advanced virtual indicators including thermohygrometric comfort, ventilation efficiency, resistance to mold growth, virus spread resistance and overall indoor air quality, with optional noise monitoring and native BMS integration via Modbus and BACnet.

inbiot/plus-lora.name: MICA Plus - Indoor Air Quality Sensor
inbiot/plus-lora.description: MICA Plus is an advanced indoor air quality monitor with LoRaWAN, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT/LTE-M and Sigfox connectivity, measuring temperature, relative humidity, CO₂, TVOC, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM4.0, PM10 and formaldehyde, and providing thermohygrometric comfort, ventilation efficiency, resistance to mold growth, virus spread resistance and indoor air quality indicators, with optional noise monitoring and seamless integration with BMS systems through Modbus and BACnet.

inbiot/well-lora.name: MICA WELL - Indoor Air Quality Sensor
inbiot/well-lora.description: MICA WELL is the most comprehensive indoor air quality monitoring device in the MICA range, featuring LoRaWAN, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT/LTE-M and Sigfox connectivity and measuring temperature, relative humidity, CO₂, TVOC, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM4.0, PM10, formaldehyde, ozone, NO₂ and CO, combined with thermohygrometric comfort, ventilation efficiency, resistance to mold growth, virus spread resistance and indoor air quality indicators, with optional noise monitoring and full compatibility with Modbus and BACnet for professional BMS and certification-driven projects.

keller/adt1-box.name: ADT1 Box - Remote Transmitter
keller/adt1-box.description: The KELLER ADT1-Box is an autonomous device that can be linked with digital level probes and pressure transmitters in the KELLER D and X product lines. The measured data can be collected through a LoRaWAN® network.

keller/arc1-tube.name: ARC1 Tube - Remote Transmitter
keller/arc1-tube.description: The KELLER ARC1-Tube is a remote transmission unit with a data logger. It records measurements made by external sensors (e.g. a level probes) and periodically transmits the collected data via LoRaWAN®.

lansitec/badge-tracker.name: Badge Tracker
lansitec/badge-tracker.description: Lansitec badge tracker is designed based on GNSS, Bluetooth 5.0 and LoRaWAN technology. It supports indoor and outdoor tracking. The badge is mainly used for personnel and asset management. Its built-in 3-axis accelerator could be used for determining the motion status of the terminal. Therefore, it can help save battery and enhance user experience.

lansitec/container-tracker.name: Container Tracker
lansitec/container-tracker.description: Lansitec Container Tracker is designed based on GNSS, Bluetooth and LoRaWAN technology for indoor and outdoor tracking. It has an ultra-long standby time and IP68 enclosure that makes it perfect for asset tracking. It is suitable for the following use cases:Container tracking, Transit case tracking, Machine usage monitor, Asset management

lansitec/helmet-sensor.name: Helmet Sensor
lansitec/helmet-sensor.description: Lansitec Helmet Sensor is designed based on GNSS, Bluetooth5.0 and LoRaWAN technology. It supports indoor and outdoor tracking. It supports various features which contribute to easy management in industrial settings. Its built-in 3-axis accelerator could be used for determining the motion status of the terminal. Therefore, it can help save battery and enhance user experience. It is suitable for the following use cases:visitor management, factory worker tracking, construction worker tracking, vehicle tracking etc.

lansitec/temperature-humidity-sensor.name: Temperature Humidity Sensor
lansitec/temperature-humidity-sensor.description: The Lansitec temperature and humidity sensor is designed based on the advanced LoRa modulation and powered by a lithium battery with a 5-year operation time. It offers a costeffective LoRaWAN end device for a variety of applications. Its IP65 enclosure and long operation time offer the benefit of low maintenance cost. Therefore, it is ideal for outdoor use. The sensor operation mode can be adjusted via LoRaWAN Network. Lansitec sensor family is fully compatible and plug-and-play for LoRaWAN network operation. It can also work with the Lansitec wireless data transfer unit for the low-cost deployment.

lansitec/precision-platinum-sensor.name: Precision Platinum Sensor
lansitec/precision-platinum-sensor.description: Lansitec precision platinum temperature sensor is designed based on the advanced LoRa modulation and powered by a lithium battery with 6-year operation time. It is a cost-effective LoRaWAN end device for a variety of application scenarios. Its long operation time offers low maintenance. Therefore, it is ideal for industrial use. The sensor work mode can be adjusted via the LoRaWAN Network. Lansitec sensor family is fully compatible and plug-and-play for the LoRaWAN network operation. Lansitec sensors can also work with Lansitec Wireless Data Transfer Unit (P/N:100-00175) for low-cost deployment. Please contact us for further information. Context:Busway temperature monitor, gas and fluid temperature monitor

makerfabs/rtd-pt1000-temperature.name: RTD PT1000 Temperature
makerfabs/rtd-pt1000-temperature.description: The AgroSense Industrial Temperature Sensor utilizes a PT1000 sensor to measure temperatures in high-temperature industrial environments, ranging from -60°C to 200°C, with an accuracy of ±0.1°C and a resolution of ±0.4%

makerfabs/light-intensity.name: Light Intensity
makerfabs/light-intensity.description: The AgroSense Light Intensity Sensor utilizes the BH1750 sensor to measure light intensity in the range of 1 to 65,535 lx, with an operating temperature range of -40°C to 85°C. It offers an accuracy of ±1 lx and a resolution of ±20%

makerfabs/barometric-pressure.name: Barometric Pressure
makerfabs/barometric-pressure.description: The AgroSense Barometric Pressure Sensor measures atmospheric pressure in the range of 300 to 1100 hPa, with an operating temperature range of -40°C to 85°C. It offers an accuracy of ±0.12 hPa and a resolution of 0.01 hPa

makerfabs/co2.name: Carbon Dioxide CO2
makerfabs/co2.description: The AgroSense The Carbon Dioxide (CO2) Sensor uses the SGP30 sensor to remotely measure CO2 levels in the atmosphere, ranging from 400 to 60,000 ppm, with an accuracy of ±20% and a resolution of 1 ppm

makerfabs/soil-moisture.name: Soil Moisture
makerfabs/soil-moisture.description: The AgroSense Soil Moisture Sensor measures humidity using a capacitive method with a 12-bit ADC, operating in the temperature range of -40°C to 85°C

makerfabs/air-temperature-and-humidity.name: Air Temperature and Humidity Sensor
makerfabs/air-temperature-and-humidity.description: The AgroSense Air Temperature & Humidity Sensor uses the AHT20 sensor to measure temperature and humidity in the range of -40°C to 85°C and 0 to 100% RH, with an accuracy of ±0.2°C and ±0.2% RH

makerfabs/temperature-humidity-sht31.name: Temperature & Humidity SHT31
makerfabs/temperature-humidity-sht31.description: The AgroSense Temperature & Humidity Sensor uses the SHT31 sensor to measure air temperature and humidity in the range of -40°C to 125°C and 0 to 100% RH, with an accuracy of ±0.2°C and ±2% RH

makerfabs/positioning-water-leak.name: Positioning Water Leak
makerfabs/positioning-water-leak.description: The AgroSense Positioning Water Leak Sensor detects water leakage at fixed points, making it ideal for applications such as garage or kitchen water leakage detection. Upon detecting leakage, it instantly reports the event via the LoRaWAN® protocol.

makerfabs/none-position-rope-water-leak.name: None-Position Rope Type Water Leak
makerfabs/none-position-rope-water-leak.description: The AgroSense Non-Position Rope Type Water Leak Sensor detects water or oil leakage along the entire length of the sensor cable. It is highly sensitive, detecting water drops at any point along the cable. Upon detecting a leak, it immediately indicates and reports the event via LoRaWAN®, making it suitable for applications such as garage or kitchen water leakage detection.

makerfabs/gps-tracker-pa1010d.name: GPS Tracker_PA1010D
makerfabs/gps-tracker-pa1010d.description: The AgroSense GPS Tracker PA1010D is an ideal GPS beacon for geolocation of equipment. It reports GPS location every hour by default, with the option to adjust reporting frequency from 5 minutes to 24 hours

makerfabs/gps-tracker-neo-6m.name: GPS Tracker NEO_6M
makerfabs/gps-tracker-neo-6m.description: The AgroSense GPS Tracker NEO_6M is an ideal GPS beacon for equipment geolocation. This product uses the U-blox NEO-6M GPS module, known for its high precision and widespread use. Equipped with an onboard LIS3DHTR accelerometer, it can detect vibration and report via LoRaWAN. It is suitable for various applications, including asset tracking and farm management

makerfabs/leaf-moisture-sn-3001.name: Leaf Moisture SN-3001
makerfabs/leaf-moisture-sn-3001.description: The AgroSense Leaf Moisture Sensor uses the SN-3001 sensor to measure leaf moisture and temperature, providing data to the platform for analyzing leaf conditions such as watering, moisturizing, dew, and freezing. It operates within a range of -40°C to 60°C and 0% to 100% RH, with an accuracy of ±0.5°C and ±3% RH, respectively.

makerfabs/pipe-pressure.name: Pipe Pressure
makerfabs/pipe-pressure.description: The AgroSense Pressure Sensor detects water or air pressure in pipes, allowing it to identify blockages or freezing conditions. When the LoRaWAN connection is temporarily unavailable. The stored data is automatically sent once the connection is restored.

makerfabs/4-channel-adc.name: 4-Channel ADC 12 bits
makerfabs/4-channel-adc.description: The AgroSense 4-Channel ADC 12-bit uses the ADS1015IDGSR chip, which supports up to 4 channels and provides high-precision analogue-to-digital conversions (ADC) with a resolution of up to 12 bits

makerfabs/soil-monitor.name: Soil Monitor
makerfabs/soil-monitor.description: The AgroSense Soil Monitor measures key soil parameters and transmits the results periodically via LoRaWAN to a cloud server for remote monitoring.

mcci/catena4430.name: Animal Activity Sensor
mcci/catena4430.description: The MCCI Catena® 4430 Activity Sensor Wing allows mounting Panasonic WL series PIR sensors and connecting additional external sensors. It can be used with MCCI Catena 4610, Catena 4612/4618, and the Adafruit Feather M0 with LoRa® radio system, but suitable for use with any Adafruit Feather CPU board.

mcci/catena4450.name: Catena® 4450 Node
mcci/catena4450.description: The MCCI Catena® 4450 Node for LoRaWAN® technology is a powerful open-source IoT device that consists of temperature, humidity, pressure, lux sensors and also allows the connection of various external sensors. It is designed specifically for use with The Things Network. It is based on the Adafruit Feather M0. The Catena 4450 Node is a ready-to-use platform for LoRaWAN 1.0 and 1.1 wireless IoT applications.

mcci/catena4460.name: Catena® 4460 Node
mcci/catena4460.description: The MCCI Catena® 4460 Node for LoRaWAN® technology is a powerful open-source IoT device that consists of temperature, humidity, pressure, lux, and volatile organic compound (VOC) sensors and also allows the connection of various external sensors. It is designed specifically for use with The Things Network. It is based on the Adafruit Feather M0. The Catena 4460 Node is a ready-to-use platform for LoRaWAN 1.0 and 1.1 wireless IoT applications.

mcci/catena4470.name: Catena® 4470 Node with Modbus
mcci/catena4470.description: The MCCI Catena® 4470 Node with Modbus for LoRaWAN® technology is a powerful open-source IoT device that consists of temperature, humidity, pressure, and lux sensors and also allows it to connect various external sensors. It is designed specifically to integrate Modbus control with The Things Network. It is based on the Adafruit Feather M0. The Catena 4470 Node with Modbus is a ready-to-use platform for LoRaWAN 1.0.2 and 1.1 wireless IoT applications.

mcci/catena4610.name: Catena® 4610 Node
mcci/catena4610.description: The MCCI Catena® 4610 is a LoRaWAN® development board that consists of temperature, humidity, pressure, infrared, white light, and UV sensors. It is based on the Murata CMWX1ZZABZ-078 and designed to be compatible with the Adafruit Feather family of development boards and accessories.The Catena 4610 is a great platform for LoRaWAN investigation and deployment.

mcci/catena4612.name: Catena® 4612 Node
mcci/catena4612.description: The MCCI Catena® 4612 is a LoRaWAN® development board that consists of temperature, humidity, pressure, infrared, white light, and UV sensors. It is based on the Murata CMWX1ZZABZ-078 and designed to be compatible with the Adafruit Feather family of development boards and accessories.The Catena 4612 Node is a great platform for LoRaWAN investigation and deployment.

mcci/catena4618.name: Catena® 4618 Node
mcci/catena4618.description: The MCCI Catena® 4618 Node is a LoRaWAN® development board that consists of temperature, humidity, infrared, white light, and UV sensors. It is based on the Murata CMWX1ZZABZ-078 and designed to be compatible with the Adafruit Feather family of development boards and accessories.The Catena 4618 is a great platform for LoRaWAN investigation and deployment.

mcci/catena4618m201.name: Catena® 4618 M201 Node
mcci/catena4618m201.description: The MCCI Catena® 4618 M201 Node is a LoRaWAN® development board that consists of temperature, humidity, infrared, white light, and UV sensors. It is based on the Murata CMWX1ZZABZ-078 and designed to be compatible with the Adafruit Feather family of development boards and accessories.The Catena 4618 M201 Node is a great platform for LoRaWAN investigation and deployment.

mcci/catena4801.name: Catena® 4801 Modbus Node
mcci/catena4801.description: General purpose LPWAN building block, open source, user-programmable single-board end-device with RS-485 Modbus interface and support

mcci/catena4802.name: Catena® 4802 Modbus/Sensor Node
mcci/catena4802.description: The MCCI Catena® 4802 RS-485/Sensor Node for LoRaWAN® technology networks is a complete open-source single-board IoT device that can monitor and control remote Modbus, M-Bus, and other industrial devices, while also monitoring temperature and humidity with an integrated Sensirion SHT31 sensor. It also incorporates a QWICC connector for easy connection of external I2C devices.

mcci/model4811.name: Model 4811 Remote Power Meter
mcci/model4811.description: Real-time power monitor for commercial and residential buildings

mcci/model4821.name: Model 4821 Indoor Environmental Sensor (BME280)
mcci/model4821.description: The MCCI® Model 4821 Indoor Environment Sensor is based on MCCI Catena 4612 which consists of temperature, humidity, pressure, and light sensors.

mcci/model4822.name: Model 4822 Indoor Environmental Sensor (SHT31)
mcci/model4822.description: The MCCI® Model 4822 Indoor Environment Sensor (SHT31) is based on MCCI Catena 4618 which consists of temperature, humidity, and light sensors.

mcci/model4823.name: Model 4823 Precision Indoor Environmental Sensor (with SHT35)
mcci/model4823.description: The MCCI® Model 4823 Precision Indoor Environment Sensor (with SHT35) is based on MCCI Catena 4618 M201 which consists of temperature, humidity, and light sensors.

mcci/model4831.name: Model 4831 Outdoor Environmental Sensor (SHT31)
mcci/model4831.description: The MCCI® Model 4831 Outdoor Environment Sensor (SHT31) is based on MCCI Catena 4618 which consists of temperature, humidity, and light sensors.

mcci/model4832.name: Model 4832 High-Accuracy Outdoor Environmental Sensor (SHT35)
mcci/model4832.description: The MCCI® Model 4832 High-Accuracy Outdoor Environment Sensor (SHT35) is based on MCCI Catena 4618 M201 which consists of temperature, humidity, and light sensors.

mcci/model4841.name: Indoor Air Quality Sensor
mcci/model4841.description: The MCCI Indoor Air Quality Sensor consists of PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, dust concentration, total volatile organic compounds, temperature, and humidity sensors. It transmits data using LoRaWAN® networks.

mcci/model4931.name: Model 4931 Outdoor Sensor
mcci/model4931.description: Temperature, humidity, pressure, rainfall, soil temperature and moisture, tree temperature and pressure, sap flow

mcci/model4933.name: Model 4933 Air Quality Gas Sensor
mcci/model4933.description: Temperature, humidity, pressure sensor, Gas sensors (CO, CO2, NO2, O3, SO2) and PM2.5

mcf88/mcf-lw06davk.name: MCF-LW06DAVK
mcf88/mcf-lw06davk.description: The mcf88 MCF-LW06DAVK is equipped with a wide range of sensors such as temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, rainfall, wind speed and direction, solar radiation, PM1, PM2.5, and PM10. Suitable for smart agriculture, industry, smart city, waste station control, etc.

mcf88/mcf-lw06davpk.name: MCF-LW06DAVPK
mcf88/mcf-lw06davpk.description: The mcf88 MCF-LW06DAVPK integrates a LoRaWAN® communication system in a Davis Instruments Vantage Pro2 Weather Station. The station is equipped with a wide range of sensors such as temperature, humidity, pressure, rainfall, dew point, wind speed, wind direction, solar radiation, PM1, PM2.5, and PM10.

mcf88/mcf-lw12co2.name: MCF-LW12CO2
mcf88/mcf-lw12co2.description: The mcf88 MCF-LW12CO2 LoRaWAN® indoor environmental sensor equipped with temperature, humidity, pressure, light intensity, air quality (expressed as IAQ or bVOC value), and CO2 sensors and sends collected data over the LoRaWAN® network. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as building automation, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, security, healthcare, and many more use cases.

mcf88/mcf-lw12co2e.name: MCF-LW12CO2E
mcf88/mcf-lw12co2e.description: The MCF-LW12CO2E is a battery powered sensor for indoor applications that reads temperature, relative humidity, pressure, ambient light, IAQ air quality index and CO2. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as home buildings, air quality monitoring and energy saving applications.

mcf88/mcf-lw12met.name: MCF-LW12MET
mcf88/mcf-lw12met.description: The mcf88 MCF-LW12MET is a LoRaWAN® Mono-Phase Energy Meter with I/O that can be used for monitoring and checking the power of electronic devices, and can remotely switch devices on/off and read the state of digital input.

mcf88/mcf-lw12plg.name: MCF-LW12PLG
mcf88/mcf-lw12plg.description: The mcf88 MCF-LW12PLG is a LoRaWAN® Energy Meter plug with On/Off capability that supports metering and switching of a 230Vac – 16 Amp Load (active, reactive, and apparent energy; Class 0.2).

mcf88/mcf-lw12ter.name: MCF-LW12TER
mcf88/mcf-lw12ter.description: The mfc88 MCF-LW12TER is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, and pressure sensor for monitoring indoor environments. The collected data is transmitted over the LoRaWAN network. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as building automation, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, security, healthcare, and many more use cases.

mcf88/mcf-lw12terwp.name: MCF-LW12TERWP
mcf88/mcf-lw12terwp.description: The mfc88 MCF-LW12TERWP is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, and pressure sensor for monitoring outdoor environments. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as weather stations, urban monitoring, air quality, industrial, environmental, or farming projects.

mcf88/mcf-lw12terpm.name: MCF-LW12TERPM
mcf88/mcf-lw12terpm.description: The mcf88 MCF-LW12TERPM is an outdoor PM and environmental sensor that consists of temperature, humidity, pressure, and PM (PM1, PM2.5, PM10) sensors. It sends collected data over the LoRaWAN® network. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as weather stations, urban monitoring, air quality, industrial, environmental, or farming projects.

mcf88/mcf-lw12voc.name: MCF-LW12VOC
mcf88/mcf-lw12voc.description: The mfc88 MCF-LW12VOC is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a temperature sensor, humidity sensor, pressure sensor, light intensity sensor, and an air quality sensor for monitoring indoor environments. Ideally suited for a wide range of applications such as building automation, condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, security, healthcare, and many more use cases.

mcf88/mcf-lw13io.name: MCF-LW13IO
mcf88/mcf-lw13io.description: The mcf88 MCF-LW13IO is a wireless actuator that consists of an Opto-isolated input and a relay output. The device transmits the status of its input and controls the output through the LoRaWAN® network. Can be used for industrial process control and home automation, water treatment, agriculture irrigation, and similar applications.

mcf88/mcf-lw13mio.name: MCF-LW13MIO
mcf88/mcf-lw13mio.description: The mcf88 MCF-LW13MIO is a LoRaWAN® multi I/O module that transmits the state of its 16 inputs and controls 8 outputs through the LoRaWAN® network. All these inputs and outputs are galvanically isolated. It can be used for industrial process control, home automation, water treatment, agriculture irrigation, and similar applications.

mcf88/mcf-lwws00.name: MCF-LWWS00
mcf88/mcf-lwws00.description: The mcf88 MCF-LWWS00 integrates a LoRaWAN® communication system in a Davis Instruments Vantage Pro2 Weather Station. The station is equipped with a wide range of sensors such as temperature, humidity, pressure, rainfall, dew point, wind speed, wind direction, solar radiation, PM1, PM2.5, and PM10. Suitable for smart agriculture, industry, smart city, and waste station control applications.

mcf88/mcf-lwws01.name: MCF-LWWS01
mcf88/mcf-lwws01.description: The mcf88 MCF-LWWS01 integrates a LoRaWAN® communication system in a Davis Instruments Vantage Pro2 Weather Station. The station is equipped with a wide range of sensors such as temperature, humidity, pressure, rainfall, dew point, wind speed, wind direction, solar radiation, PM1, PM2.5, and PM10. mcf88/mcf-lwws02.name: MCF-LWWS02
mcf88/mcf-lwws02.description: The mcf88 MCF-LWWS02 integrates a LoRaWAN® communication system in a Davis Instruments Vantage Pro2 Weather Station. mcf88/mcf-lwws03.name: MCF-LWWS03
mcf88/mcf-lwws03.description: The mcf88 MCF-LWWS03 integrates a LoRaWAN® communication system in a Davis Instruments Vantage Pro2 Weather Station.
