Suitable for smart agriculture, industry, smart city, and waste station control applications.

micropelt/mlr003.name: MLR003 - LoRaWAN® TRV
micropelt/mlr003.description: MLR003 is a maintenance free, intelligent thermostatic radiator valve actuator.It is an 868MHz LoRaWAN® Class A device operating in SF7BW125.

micropelt/mlrtps1.name: MLRTPS1 - Thermostat
micropelt/mlrtps1.description: MLRTPS1 is a wall mount thermostat with presence detection and temperature set point. It is an 868MHz LoRaWAN® Class A device operating in SF7BW125.

mikrotik/tg-lr82.name: tg-lr82
mikrotik/tg-lr82.description: Programmable temperature, humidity, orientation, motion and magnetic switch sensor.

minol-zenner/edc-communication-module.name: EDC COMMUNICATION MODULE FOR WATER METERS
minol-zenner/edc-communication-module.description: The EDC communication module is an add-on module for water meters for secure remote reading and for integrating water meters into smart metering systems

moirelabs/p1ap.name: Pressure Transducer
moirelabs/p1ap.description: The Moire Labs Digital pressure transducer P1AP is a telemetry-enabled, battery-powered pressure sensor, which is primarily used to measure pressure in distribution pipes of gasses or liquids and sending the measured data over the wireless network into centralized measurement systems such as SCADA.

moirelabs/p1at.name: Temperature Transducer
moirelabs/p1at.description: The Moire Labs Digital temperature transducer P1AT is a telemetry-enabled, battery-powered LoRaWAN® temperature sensor, which is primarily used to measure temperature in distribution pipes of gasses or liquids and sending the measured data over the wireless network into centralized measurement systems such as SCADA.

moko/lw001-bgpro.name: LW001-BG PRO - Tracker
moko/lw001-bgpro.description: Ultra-low power consumption, indoor&outdoor(BLE&WIFI&GPS) LoRaWAN Tracker

moko/lw003-b.name: LW003-B - Bluetooth Probe
moko/lw003-b.description: The Moko Smart LW003-B integrates LoRaWAN® and Bluetooth wireless communication. It can scan BLE Beacon data and send data to the LoRaWAN gateway, and then upload it to the server to realize environmental monitoring and indoor positioning.

moko/lw004.name: LW004 - Panic Button
moko/lw004.description: LW004 is LoRaWAN based panic button with positioning function, with a compact and smart outlook, and easy to use. It integrates BLE and GPS that is specially designed for indoor and outdoor positioning of object or person.

moko/lw005-mp.name: LW005 - Smart Plug
moko/lw005-mp.description: LW005 is a compact, multi-purposes, easy-to -use, wireless LoRaWAN power meter for indoor use. It can remotely control the output switch and detect the output power.

mutelcor/mtc-pb01.name: LoRa Panic Button with Confirmation
mutelcor/mtc-pb01.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Panic Button with Confirmation is a LoRaWAN® emergency response device that enables users to quickly raise an alarm, notify security and to seek assistance in a matter of seconds by pressing a button. Its unique confirmation feature can indicate if the button-press has been received and acknowledged by the backend application. A physical feedback to the button press using a buzzer and LED can be configured.

mutelcor/mtc-co2-01.name: Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor (IP30, IP54)
mutelcor/mtc-co2-01.description: The Mutelcor Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor is a unique power-driven Air Quality sensor. It measures CO2, Temperature and Humidity every 2 seconds with a robust dual-channel NDIR sensor and offers automatic Traffic Light Feature with local and LoRa-based Alarms based on multi-color LEDs and Sound. The device offers plug-and-play handling with multiple Threshold settings and quick and easy Calibration.

mutelcor/mtc-mh01.name: LoRa Manhole Sensor
mutelcor/mtc-mh01.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Manhole Sensor is a LoRaWAN® Device that detects opening and closing of manholes and/or any external doors. The device notifies alerts in real time to prevent accidents and to quickly react to unauthorized opening of manholes and external doors.

mutelcor/mtc-scb01.name: LoRa Service Call Button
mutelcor/mtc-scb01.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Service Call Button is a LoRaWAN® Device that raises alarms or requests to multiple services for help, assistance or support from a single device in real time in a matter of seconds by pressing a button. A physical feedback to the button press using a buzzer and LED can be configured.

mutelcor/mtc-aq01.name: LoRa Air Quality Sensor (IP30, IP67)
mutelcor/mtc-aq01.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Air Quality Sensor is a LoRaWAN® Device that measures wirelessly Temperature and Humidity in Regfrigerators, Deep Freezers, including indoor applications like Corporate Buildings & Healthcare centers (ICUs Operation Theatre & Medical Labs) and Triggers alarms on exceeded thresholds.

mutelcor/mtc-nfc02.name: NFC RFID - LoRa Button
mutelcor/mtc-nfc02.description: The Mutelcor NFC RFID - LoRa Button makes it easy to combine sending alarm messages via LoRa with an option to authenticate using a NFC Tag by holding it next to the device when pressing a button. Our dynamic web-dashboard allows you to monitor the status of deployed NFC RFID - LoRa Buttons, handle events sent and collect statistics about device usage. Other Mutelcor products can be monitored using the same dashboard.

mutelcor/mtc-aqb01.name: LoRa Air Quality Button (IP30, IP54)
mutelcor/mtc-aqb01.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Air Quality Button is a LoRaWAN® Device that combines sending LoRa messages on a button press with measuring wirelessly Temperature and Humidity. Can be used for indoor applications like Corporate Buildings & Healthcare centers to combine monitoring of the Air Quality with an integrated Service Call Button or Emergency Button.

mutelcor/mtc-mf01.name: LoRa Multi-Function Device
mutelcor/mtc-mf01.description: The Mutelcor LoRa Multi-Function Device is a LoRaWAN® Device that allows you to connect up to 3 external switches. Whenever the status of a connected switch changes, a LoRa message is sent indicating which switch status changed and what the status of the other connected switches is. Can be used to combine e.g. monitoring of a manhole cover with a float sensor inside the manhole to alert on a rising water level.

mutelcor/mtc-co2-05.name: LoRa Wireless CO2 Sensor
mutelcor/mtc-co2-05.description: The Mutelcor Wireless CO2 Sensor is the batteryu powered version of our well known Smart CO2 LoRa Sensor. It measures CO2 levels along with temperature and humidity at configurable intervals, by default once every hour. With that configuration, we're able to achieve a battery life of about 2 years. Ideal for installations where regular monitoring of CO2 levels is required, but real time alerts are not critical, e.g. mushroom farming, industrial complexes and many more.

mutelcor/mtc-pm01.name: LoRa PM2.5 Sensor
mutelcor/mtc-pm01.description: The Mutelcor LoRa PM2.5 Sensor measures particulate matter values PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 at a configurable interval and transmits the values via LoRaWAN allowing the calculation of AQI and creation of alerts when crossing thresholds in the backend application. It detects particles as small as 0.3 µm using a Laser-scattering sensor.

n-fuse/sta.name: Action button
n-fuse/sta.description: Action Button with tactile feedback in a very compact Form Factor

n-fuse/ste.name: Environment sensor
n-fuse/ste.description: Environment sensor. BME680 (IAQ, CO2-e, bVOC-e, pressure, temperature, humidity).

n-fuse/stx.name: Multisensor
n-fuse/stx.description: Multisensor variant with five sensor measurements. HDC2080 (Temperature, Humidity), BMA400 (accelerometer), SFH7776 (luminance), Reed switch (magnet sensing switch).

netvox/r309.name: R309 - Wireless Wearable Emergency Button with Inactivity Detection
netvox/r309.description: R309 is a wireless emergency button alarm device, which can realize the wireless alarm function together with other devices through the buttons on the device. At the same time, the device has built-in vibration sensors to further improve the alarm system.

netvox/r311a.name: R311A - Wireless Window Sensor
netvox/r311a.description: The Netvox R311A Wireless Door/Window Sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device that contains a magnetic sensor (reed switch) for detecting the opening and closing of doors and windows. When the opening or closing status is detected an uplink containing the desired values is transferred to the LoRaWAN® network. The device provides low power consumption and longer battery life.

netvox/r311b.name: R311B - Wireless Light Sensor
netvox/r311b.description: The Netvox R311B Wireless Light Sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device that contains a light sensor for detecting ambient illumination. The R311B reports the illuminance periodically along with some other information to the LoRaWAN® network. The device provides low power consumption and longer battery life.

netvox/r311ca.name: R311CA - Wireless 2-Input Dry Contact Interface
netvox/r311ca.description: Netvox wireless dry contact sensors can be used to detect contact between two wired contact points. It can realize wireless alarm and other functions through built-in wireless module, and is compatible with LoRaWAN protocol. It can be easily networked with other related devices. The R311CA is durable and ensures optimum use and is a low power consumption device. Due to their small size, they can be installed anywhere, they are wireless, so they take up very little space.

netvox/r311cb.name: R311CB - Wireless Window/Door Sensor and Wireless Glass Sensor
netvox/r311cb.description: The R311CB device has a built-in reed switch sensor and can be externally connected to the reed switch. It can be used for door and window switch status detection and externally connected to broken glass sensor to detect the glass status. It uses the SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r311cc.name: R311CC - Wireless 2-Gang Window/Door Sensor
netvox/r311cc.description: R311CC is equipped with two external reed switches, which can be used for door and window switch state detection. The built-in wireless module can realize wireless alarm and other functions, and is compatible with the LoRaWAN protocol.

netvox/r311da.name: R311DA - Wireless Vibration Sensor, Rolling Ball Type
netvox/r311da.description: The Netvox R311DA Wireless Vibration Sensor comes with a dual ball type single direction tilt sensitive trigger switch capable of detecting movements and vibrations. When the device detects movement or vibration, it immediately sends a message to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r311db.name: R311DB - Wireless Vibration Sensor, Spring Type
netvox/r311db.description: The Netvox R311DB Wireless Vibration Sensor, Spring Type is a LoRaWAN® end device that contains a vibration sensor for detecting movements and vibrations. When a movement or vibration is detected an uplink containing the desired values is transferred to the LoRaWAN® network. The device provides low power consumption and longer battery life.

netvox/r311fa.name: R311FA - Wireless Activity Detection
netvox/r311fa.description: The Netvox R311FA Wireless Activity Detection sensor comes with an accelerometer that supports the detection of sudden movements and vibrations. When the device detects movement or vibration, it immediately sends a message to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r311fa1.name: R311FA1 - Wireless 3-axis Accelerometer Sensor
netvox/r311fa1.description: When the device moves or shakes beyond the set threshold, it immediately reports the current acceleration and velocity of the X, Y, and Z axes.

netvox/r311fb.name: R311FB - Wireless Activity Event Counter
netvox/r311fb.description: The device detects the number of movements or vibrations (such as detecting the motor a few times a day), the maximum number of movements or vibrations can reach 2^32 times (theoretical value), and sends the information of the number of movements or vibrations to the gateway for processing. Apply SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r311fc.name: R311FC - Wireless Activity Timer
netvox/r311fc.description: The device detects the duration of the movement or vibration (timekeeping) and sends the duration or timing information of the movement or vibration to the gateway for processing. The duration of the movement or vibration can be up to 1000 hours (theoretical value). Apply SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r311g.name: R311G - Wireless Light Sensor
netvox/r311g.description: The Netvox R311G Wireless Light Sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device that consists of a built-in photosensitive sensor that can be used for detecting the surrounding illuminance. With two CR2450 coin-cell batteries, R311G provides low power consumption and longer battery life.

netvox/r311k.name: R311K - Wireless Tilt Sensor
netvox/r311k.description: This device is a tilt detection sensor. When the device (defaults to the vertical direction ) has a tilt of 45 degrees or more in any direction, a tilt signal will be issued. The detected data is transmitted to other devices through the wireless network.

netvox/r311w.name: R311W - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r311w.description: The Netvox R311W Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r311wa.name: R311WA - Wireless Seat Sensor
netvox/r311wa.description: The NETVOX wireless seat sensor (two way) R311W A is a device that detects the presence of a seat and is compatible with the LoRaWAN protocol. If there is someone on the seat, R311WA will send a message to the gateway. When detecting no one on a sensor seat, it will send an normal status message back to the gateway.

netvox/r312.name: R312 - Wireless Door Bell Button
netvox/r312.description: The Netvox R312 Wireless Door Bell Button is a LoRaWAN® end device that contains a push button for detecting button presses by the user. When a button press is detected an uplink containing the desired values is transferred to the LoRaWAN® network. The device provides low power consumption and longer battery life.

netvox/r312a.name: R312A - Wireless Emergency Button
netvox/r312a.description: The Netvox R312A Wireless Emergency Button is a LoRaWAN® end device that contains a push button for detecting button presses by the user. When a button press is detected an uplink containing the desired values is transferred to the LoRaWAN® network. The device provides low power consumption and longer battery life.

netvox/r31501.name: R31501 - Wireless Internal Vibration / PIR / Water Leak / Reed Switch / Glass Break Sensor
netvox/r31501.description: R31501 is a comprehensive detection device with PIR detection, internal vibration sensor detection, water leakage detection, magnetic door switch detection and glass breaking state detection.

netvox/r31502.name: R31502 - Wireless Temperature / Humidity / Light / Tilt / Reed Switch / External Vibration Sensor
netvox/r31502.description: R31502 is a comprehensive detection device integrating temperature and humidity, Illuminance, tilt, reed switch, external vibration sensor detection.

netvox/r31503.name: R31503 - Wireless Temperature / Humidity / PIR / Emergency Button / Tilt / Water Leak Sensor
netvox/r31503.description: R31503 is a comprehensive detection device with temperature and humidity, PIR, emergency button, tilt, water leak detection.

netvox/r31504.name: R31504 - Wireless Temperature / Humidity / PIR / Emergency Button / Reed Switch / Seat Occupancy Sensor
netvox/r31504.description: R31504 is a comprehensive detection device with temperature and humidity, PIR, emergency button, reed switch, seat occupancy detection.

netvox/r31505.name: R31505 - Wireless Temperature / Humidity / Internal Vibration / Tilt / Reed Switch / External Vibration Sensor
netvox/r31505.description: R31505 is a comprehensive detection device with temperature and humidity, internal vibration, tilt, reed switch, external vibration detection.

netvox/r31506.name: R31506 - Wireless Temperature / Humidity / Internal Vibration / PIR / Emergency Button / Tilt Sensor
netvox/r31506.description: R31506 is a comprehensive detection device with temperature and humidity, internal vibration, PIR, emergency button, tilt detection.

netvox/r31507.name: R31507 - Wireless PIR / Emergency Button / Dry Contact Input / Digital Output / Glass Break Sensor
netvox/r31507.description: R31507 is a comprehensive detection device with PIR, emergency button, dry contact in, DO out, glass break detection.

netvox/r31508.name: R31508 - Wireless Temperature / Humidity / PIR / Tilt / Dry Contact Input / Digital Output Sensor
netvox/r31508.description: R31508 is a comprehensive detection device with temperature and humidity, PIR, tilt, dry contact in, DO out, glass break detection.

netvox/r31509.name: R31509 - Wireless Temperature / Humidity / Light / Water Leak / Reed Switch / Dry Contact Input Sensor
netvox/r31509.description: R31509 is a comprehensive detection device with temperature and humidity,light sensor, water leak,reed switch, dry contact in detection.

netvox/r31510.name: R31510 - Wireless Temperature / Humidity / Light / PIR / Water Leak / External Vibration Sensor
netvox/r31510.description: R31510 is a comprehensive detection device with temperature and humidity, light sensor, PIR, water leak, external vibration detection.

netvox/r711.name: R711 - Wireless Temperature and Humidity Sensor
netvox/r711.description: The Netvox R711 Wireless Temperature and Humidity Sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a built-in temperature and humidity sensor. Suitable for monitoring indoor ambient temperature and humidity.

netvox/r711a.name: R711A - Wireless Temperature Sensor
netvox/r711a.description: R711A is mainly used to detect the temperature of indoor air. It transmits the collected data to other devices for display through the wireless network communication module.

netvox/r718a.name: R718A - Temperature and Humidity Sensor for Low Temperature Environment
netvox/r718a.description: The Netvox R718A Temperature and Humidity Sensor - for Low Temperature Environment contains a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor that is capable of measuring temperature and humidity at low-temperature environments. Ideal for use in domestic and commercial refrigerators to measure temperature and humidity when storing and transporting food, medicines, flowers, and other goods. The measured data will be sent to a LoRaWAN® network for further processing.

netvox/r718ab.name: R718AB - Wireless Temperature and Humidity Sensor
netvox/r718ab.description: The Netvox R718AB - Temperature and Humidity Sensor is ideal for measuring ambient temperature and humidity in residential and commercial buildings.

netvox/r718ad.name: R718AD - Wireless Temperature Sensor
netvox/r718ad.description: The R718AD is a wireless communication device for detecting temperature. The temperature sensor probe contacts an object to detect the temperature, and the detected data is transmitted to other devices through a wireless network. The SX1276 wireless communication module is used.

netvox/r718b.name: R718B - Wireless Resistance Temperature Detector
netvox/r718b.description: The Netvox R718B - Wireless Resistance Temperature Detector comes with an external resistance temperature detector (PT1000) sensor to measure the temperature. The device can be used with a round-head, needle, or L-type probe. Suitable for measuring temperature in ovens, industrial control equipment, and for the semiconductor industry.

netvox/r718b2.name: R718B2 - Wireless 2-Gang Temperature Sensor
netvox/r718b2.description: R718B2 connects two external resistance temperature detectors (PT1000) to measures the temperature.

netvox/r718ck.name: R718CK - Wireless Thermocouple Sensor
netvox/r718ck.description: The Netvox R718CK consists of a thermocouple sensor for detecting the temperature of objects and mediums in which the thermocouple is contacted. It uses the SX1276 wireless communication module for LoRaWAN® communication.

netvox/r718ck2.name: R718CK2 - Wireless 2-Gang Thermocouple Sensor
netvox/r718ck2.description: This equipment is used to detect temperature of the object and medium which thermocouple is contacted. It can be connected to two thermocouples for testing. It uses SX1276 wireless communication module. R718CX2 can be connected according to requirements [ type K (R718CK2), type T thermocouple (R718CT2), type R thermocouple (R718CR2), type N thermocouple (R718CN2). The collected data is displayed in the gateway.]

netvox/r718cn.name: R718CN - Wireless Thermocouple Sensor - Type N
netvox/r718cn.description: This equipment is used to detect temperature of the object and medium which thermocouple is contacted. It uses SX1276 wireless communication module. Type N thermocouple (R718CN), and it will display the collected data in the gateway.

netvox/r718cn2.name: R718CN2 - Wireless 2-Gang Thermocouple Sensor - Type N
netvox/r718cn2.description: This equipment is used to detect temperature of the object and medium which thermocouple is contacted.

netvox/r718ct.name: R718CT - Wireless Thermocouple Sensor
netvox/r718ct.description: The Netvox R718CT consists of a thermocouple sensor for detecting the temperature of objects and mediums in which the thermocouple is contacted. It uses the SX1276 wireless communication module for LoRaWAN® communication.

netvox/r718ct2.name: R718CT2 - Wireless 2-Gang Thermocouple Sensor
netvox/r718ct2.description: This equipment is used to detect temperature of the object and medium which thermocouple is contacted. It can be connected to two thermocouples for testing. It uses SX1276 wireless communication module. R718CX2 can be connected according to requirements [type K (R718CK2), type T thermocouple (R718CT2), type R thermocouple (R718CR2), type N thermocouple (R718CN2). The collected data is displayed in the gateway.]

netvox/r718da.name: R718DA - Wireless Vibration Sensor
netvox/r718da.description: The Netvox R718DA - Wireless Vibration Sensor comes with an external rolling ball type sensor. Ideal for detecting movements and vibrations of the attached object.

netvox/r718da2.name: R718DA2 - Wireless 2-Gang Vibration Sensor
netvox/r718da2.description: R718DA2 is equipped with two external rolling ball type vibration sensors. When either of the vibration sensors moves or vibrates, R718DA2 can detect vibration or moving signals and send an alert to data center through LoRaWAN™. It is fully compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (Class A).

netvox/r718db.name: R718DB - Wireless Vibration Sensor
netvox/r718db.description: The Netvox R718DB - Wireless Vibration Sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device equipped with an external spring-type vibration sensor for detecting movements and vibrations.

netvox/r718db2.name: R718DB2 - Wireless 2-Gang Vibration Sensor Spring Type
netvox/r718db2.description: R718DB2 is equipped with two external spring type vibration sensors. When either of the vibration sensors moves or vibrates, R718DB2 can detect vibration or moving signals and send an alert to data center through LoRaWAN™. It is fully compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (Class A).

netvox/r718e.name: R718E - Three-Axis Digital Accelerometer&NTC Thermistor
netvox/r718e.description: The Netvox R718E Three-Axis Digital Accelerometer & NTC Thermistor is a LoRaWAN® end device that contains a 3-axis accelerometer and an external NTC thermistor that can detect the movement or vibration and the surface temperature of the measured object.

netvox/r718ea.name: R718EA - Wireless Tilt Angle and Surface Temperature Sensor
netvox/r718ea.description: The R718EA is a Wireless Tilt Angle and Surface Temperature Sensor of Netvox ClassA type devices based on the LoRaWAN open protocol and is compatible with the LoRaWAN protocol. It has a built-in tilt sensor and connect external NTC thermistor. When the device detects tilt or temperature change, it will report an uplink packet with the data of tilt angle and temperature. The NTC thermistor detects surface temperature of object.

netvox/r718eb.name: R718EB - Wireless Tilt Angle Sensor
netvox/r718eb.description: R718EB has a built-in tilt angle detection sensor. When the device is tilted (compared with the reference angle), the tilt angle will be reported, and the detected data will be transmitted to other devices through the wireless network for display.

netvox/r718f.name: R718F - Wireless Reed Switch Open/Close Detection Sensor
netvox/r718f.description: The Netvox R718F - Wireless Reed Switch Open/Close Detection Sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a reed switch to detect whether two objects are separated or not. Ideal for detecting the status of a door or window for security purposes.

netvox/r718f2.name: R718F2 - Wireless 2-Gang Reed Switch Open/Close Detection Sensor
netvox/r718f2.description: R718F2 is a 2-gang open/close detection sensor that utilizes 2 reed switches to detect whether two objects are separated or not. An example of R718F2’s application is to detect the state of a door or window for security purposes. It is based on SX1276 wireless communication module, and the communication is fully compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (Class A).

netvox/r718g.name: R718G - Wireless Light Sensor
netvox/r718g.description: The device has a built-in light sensor that can be used for ambient light intensity detection. It uses the SX1276 wireless communication module. The R718G detects the ambient light intensity value and adds it to the gateway. The collected data is displayed in other devices

netvox/r718h.name: R718H - Wireless Pulse Counter Interface
netvox/r718h.description: The device is connected with a pulse detection interface, which can calculate the number of pulses and send the detected number of pulses to the gateway display. It uses the SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r718h2.name: R718H2 - Wireless 2-Input Pulse Counter
netvox/r718h2.description: The device is connected with two pulse detection interfaces, which can calculate the number of pulses and send the detected number of pulses to the gateway display. It uses the SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r718ia.name: R718IA - Wireless 0-5V ADC Sampling Interface
netvox/r718ia.description: The device is designed for a variety of resistive bridge-sensing applications like pressure, temperature, and level-sensing applications. It can also support other applications, weight scale and force-sensing applications that use strain gauge load cells, and other general resistive bridge signal-conditioning applications.

netvox/r718ia2.name: R718IA2 - Wireless 2-Input 0-5V ADC Sampling Interface
netvox/r718ia2.description: This device can be connected to an ADC sampling interface device. As shown in the figure, black is the ground line, red is the ADC sampling interface line, and the ADC sampling voltage range is 0-5V. It uses the SX1276 wireless communication module. The wireless communication is compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (ClassA).

netvox/r718ib2.name: R718IB2 - Wireless 2-Input 0-10V ADC Sampling Interface
netvox/r718ib2.description: This device can be connected to an ADC sampling interface device. As shown in the figure, black is the ground line, red is the ADC sampling interface line, and the ADC sampling voltage range is 0-10V. It uses the SX1276 wireless communication module. The wireless communication is compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (ClassA).

netvox/r718ijk.name: R718IJK - Wireless Multi-Sensor Interface for 0-24V ADC, Dry Contact and 4-20mA Sensors
netvox/r718ijk.description: This device is used for detecting 4mA-20mA signal, 0-24V DC ADC samples and dry contact features which employs SX1276 wireless communication module . R718IJK can detect 4mA-20mA signal, 0-24V DC ADC sampling signal and dry contact input signal, and send the detection signal data to the gateway, and display the collected data in the monitoring platform.

netvox/r718j.name: R718J - Wireless Dry Contact Interface
netvox/r718j.description: The Netvox R718J-Wireless Dry Contact Interface can be used to detect many different inputs such as smoke sensors, security systems, air conditioning status, UPS status, etc.

netvox/r718j2.name: R718J2 - Wireless 2-Input Dry Contact Interface
netvox/r718j2.description: R718J2 can be connected to external dry contact devices, such as various switches, buttons, relays and reed switch outputs. It can detect the closure or disconnection signal of the dry contacts. Based on SX1276 wireless communication module, the wireless communication is compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (ClassA).

netvox/r718ka.name: R718KA - Wireless-mA Current Meter Interface, 4~20mA
netvox/r718ka.description: The Wireless 4-20mA DC Current Meter is designed to offer a large selection of easy-to-use current 4-20mA data loggers for load monitoring. The wireless communication is compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (ClassA).

netvox/r718ka2.name: R718KA2 - Wireless 2-Input-mA Current Meter Interface, 4~20mA
netvox/r718ka2.description: The Wireless 4-20mA DC Current Meter is designed to offer a large selection of easy-to-use current 4-20mA data loggers for load monitoring. The wireless communication is compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (ClassA).

netvox/r718lb.name: R718LB - Wireless Hall Type Open/Close
netvox/r718lb.description: The Netvox R718LB - Hall Type Open/Close is a LoRaWAN® end device that consists of a hall-effect sensor to detect the open and close state of anything, for example detecting the opening and closing of doors and windows.

netvox/r718lb2.name: R718LB2 - Wireless 2-Gang Hall Type Open/Close Detection Sensor
netvox/r718lb2.description: This device is equipped with two way Hall sensors, which can be used for door and window switch state detection. It can realize wireless alarm and other functions through the built-in wireless module. It applys SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r718mba.name: R718MBA - Wireless Activity Detection
netvox/r718mba.description: The Netvox R718MBA Wireless Activity Detection Sensor detects sudden movements or vibrations and alerts through the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r718mbb.name: R718MBB - Wireless Activity Event Counter
netvox/r718mbb.description: The device detects the number of movements or vibrations (such as detecting the motor a few times a day), the maximum number of movements or vibrations can reach 232 times (theoretical value), and sends the information of the number of movements or vibrations to the gateway for processing. Apply SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r718mbc.name: R718MBC - Wireless Activity Timer
netvox/r718mbc.description: The device detects the duration of the movement or vibration (timekeeping) and sends the duration or timing information of the movement or vibration to the gateway for processing. The duration of the movement or vibration can be up to 1000 hours (theoretical value). SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r718n1.name: R718N1 - Wireless 1-Phase Current Meter with 1 x 30A Solid Core CT
netvox/r718n1.description: The Netvox R718N1 1-Phase Current Meter is a LoRaWAN® end device with an external solid-core current transformer that can be used to obtain the single-phase current of a live wire. R718N1 series have different measuring range for different variety of CT; 30A (Solid Core CT and Clamp-On CT types), 75A (Clamp-On CT), 150A (Clamp-On CT), 250A (Clamp-On CT), 630A (Clamp-On CT).

netvox/r718nl1.name: R718NL1 - Wireless Light Sensor and 1-Phase Current Meter with 1x(30A, 75A, 150A, 250A, 630A)Clamp-On CT
netvox/r718nl1.description: The NETVOX Wireless Light Sensor and 1-Phase Current Meter with 1x30A Clamp-On CT is used to detect single-phase electrical input current and ambient light intensity detection. The device is compatible with the LoRaWAN protocol, and integrates a chip module that conforms to the LoRaWAN wireless protocol to display the collected data in the gateway. The device adopts the split-core current transformer, which can be conveniently connected to the measuring device. R718NL1 series have different measuring range for different variety of CT(30A, 75A, 150A, 250A, 630A).

netvox/r718n3.name: R718N3 - Wireless 3-Phase Current Meter With 3 x 50A Solid Core CT
netvox/r718n3.description: The Netvox R718N3 3-Phase Current Meter is a LoRaWAN® end device with three external solid-core current transformers that can be used to obtain the current of a three-phase wiring system. R718N3 series have different measuring range for different variety of CT; 3 x 50A(Solid Core CT), 3 x 75A (Clamp-On CT), 3 x 150A (Clamp-On CT), 3 x 250A (Clamp-On CT), 3 x 630A (Clamp-On CT).

netvox/r718n360.name: R718N360 - Wireless 3-Phase Current Meter Interface
netvox/r718n360.description: The NETVOX wireless three-phase current interface which can detect the current can be connected with the different CTs by the user. The device is compatible with the LoRaWAN protocol and integrates a chip module that conforms to the LoRaWAN wireless protocol to display the collected data in the gateway. The device is powered by battery and obtains the load AC current value through the current transformer.

netvox/r718nl3.name: R718NL3 - Wireless Light Sensor and 3-Phase Current Meter with 3x150A Clamp-On CT
netvox/r718nl3.description: The NETVOX Wireless Light Sensor and 3-Phase Current Meter with 3x150A Clamp-On CT is used to detect three-phase electrical input current and ambient light intensity detection. The device is compatible with the LoRaWAN protocol, and integrates a chip module that conforms to the LoRaWAN wireless protocol to display the collected data in the gateway. The device adopts the split-core current transformer, which can be conveniently connected to the measuring device.

netvox/r718t.name: R718T - Wireless Push Button Interface
netvox/r718t.description: The Netvox R718T-Wireless Push Button Interface is a LoRaWAN® end device that sends a notification signal when the connected push button is pushed. Ideal for building panic buttons for emergency assistance.

netvox/r718pe.name: R718PE - Wireless Top Mounted Ultrasonic Liquid Level Sensor
netvox/r718pe.description: R718PE is a wireless communication device that uses ultrasound to detect the distance between the device and the detected object. The medium the device detects is the air, so the detected object can be any liquid or solid that has a flat and horizontal surface, water level for example. The main body and the sensor of R718PE communicates via the UART serial port, and the detected data can be transmitted via LoRa communication.

netvox/r718q.name: R718Q - Wireless Short-Range Occupancy Sensor
netvox/r718q.description: The Netvox R718PQ-Wireless Short-Range Occupancy Sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device that has a built-in PIR sensor (pyroelectric human body infrared sensor) for detecting someone, for example detecting someone has entered a room.

netvox/r718qa.name: R718QA - Wireless Toilet Occupancy Sensor
netvox/r718qa.description: The Netvox R718PQA-Wireless Toilet Occupancy Sensor is a LoRaWAN® end device equipped with a reed switch sensor and a built-in PIR sensor (pyroelectric human body infrared sensor). Suitable occupancy detection for a room, for example, detecting if someone is in the toilet.

netvox/r718t2.name: R718T2 - Wireless 2-Input Push Button Interface
netvox/r718t2.description: The Wireless 2-Input Push Button Interface allows a notification signal to be sent when connected push button is pushed. When someone is in danger and needs emergency assistance, press the emergency push button device; R718T2 immediately sends an alarm message to the gateway.

netvox/r718ubb.name: R718UBB - Wireless Multifunctional CO2 Sensor
netvox/r718ubb.description: R718UBB all-in-one series is a ClassA type testing device based on LoRaWAN open protocol of Netvox, which can support multiple combinations of temperature and humidity, CO2, vibration, atmospheric pressure and illumination sensors, and is compatible with LoRaWAN protocol.

netvox/r718ubd.name: R718UBD - Wireless Multifunctional CO2 Sensor
netvox/r718ubd.description: R718UBD series is a wireless communication device that can detect CO2 in the environment and can be combined with a variety of sensors. And transmits the detected data to other devices through the wireless network for display, which adopts the SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r718wa.name: R718WA - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r718wa.description: The Netvox R311W Water Leak Detector comes with one water leak sensor suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r718wa2.name: R718WA2 - Wireless 2-Gang Water Leak Detector
netvox/r718wa2.description: The device is a LoRaWAN™ device compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (Class A). When the sensor detects the leak, it will send an alarm message to the gateway. R718WA2 carries 2 water leak sensors. It uses SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r718waa.name: R718WAA - Wireless Water Leakage/Temperature/Humidity Sensor
netvox/r718waa.description: This device is used for water leakage detection and environmental temperature and humidity detection. When the water leakage sensor detects water leakage, it will send an alarm message to the gateway.

netvox/r718wb.name: R718WB - Wireless Water Leak Detector with Rope Sensor
netvox/r718wb.description: R718WB is a non-locating leak detection wireless communication device. R718WB can detect the leak status through an external dual-core non-positioning water rope sensor, and send the detected data to data center through the wireless network.

netvox/r718wb2.name: R718WB2 - Wireless Water Two Gang Leak Detector with Rope Sensor
netvox/r718wb2.description: The device is a LoRaWAN™ device compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol (Class A). When the sensor detects the leak, it will send an alarm message to the gateway. R718WB2 carries 2 water rope sensors. It uses SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r718wba.name: R718WBA - Wireless Temperature and Humidity Sensor & Water Leakage
netvox/r718wba.description: The R718WBA is a wireless communication device that detects ambient air temperature and humidity and non-locating leak detection. The R718WBA detects the temperature and humidity of the air. At the same time, it detects the presence or absence of water leakage through the 2-core non-locating leak detection sensor line, and transmits the detected data to the gateway through the wireless network. The SX1276 wireless communication module is used.

netvox/r718x.name: R718X - Wireless Ultrasonic Distance Sensor
netvox/r718x.description: R718X is a wireless device that detect distance by ultrasonic ranging sensor. R718X also equips an NTC temperature sensor and will send alarm message while detecting abnormal temperature.

netvox/r718y.name: R718Y - Wireless Differential Pressure and Temperature Sensor
netvox/r718y.description: R718Y is a wireless communication device which can detect the pressure difference. It will transmit the detected data to other devices for display through the wireless network.

netvox/r720a.name: R720A - Temperature and Humidity Sensor
netvox/r720a.description: The Netvox R720A-Temperature and Humidity Sensor has a built-in temperature sensor and a humidity sensor that measures ambient temperature and humidity. The measured data will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network for further processing and alerting.

netvox/r720b.name: R720B - Wireless Temperature and Humidity Sensor with Activity Detection Sensor
netvox/r720b.description: The R720B is a wireless communication device that detects ambient air temperature and humidity. The R720B also detects if it is being moved. The R720B can transmit the detected data to other devices via the wireless network, using the SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r720c.name: R720C - Wireless Air Pressure and Temperature Sensor
netvox/r720c.description: The R720C is a wireless communication device that detects ambient air pressure and temperature. The R720C detects ambient air pressure and temperature and transmits the detected data to other devices via a wireless network using the SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r720e.name: R720E - Wireless TVOC Detection Sensor
netvox/r720e.description: R720E is a wireless communication device that detects temperature, humidity and TVOC. TVOC refers to all organic gaseous substances in a space, and generally refers to the indoor volatile organic substances. TVOC is also the much serious one of the three types of pollution affecting indoor air quality. R720E can detect the concentration value of TVOC.

netvox/r720f.name: R720F - Wireless Liquid Hand Soap Sensor
netvox/r720f.description: R720F series is a wireless communication device that can detect the existence of hand sanitizer / water leakage. This device is connected with two electrode rods which can be used to detect the state of the insufficient amount of hand sanitizer in the hand sanitizer box or whether there is the water leakage in the detection area.The shape and orientation of electrode rod can be selected according to the needs (R720FLO,R720FLD,R720FU). The electrode rod can be trimmed to the required length by self according to the demand.The function of water leakage detection can choose R720FW.

netvox/r720g.name: R720G - Wireless GPS Tracker with tilt angle
netvox/r720g.description: R720G is a compact GPS tracking device with built-in three-axis acceleration sensor. And transmits the detected data to other devices through the wireless network for display, which adopts the SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r720flt.name: R720FLT - Wireless Toilet Water Tank Leakage Sensor
netvox/r720flt.description: R720FLT is connected with two electrode rods to detect the water make-up of the toilet water tank, detect the daily water makeup times and whether the water tank is faulty, and transmit the detected data to other devices through the wireless network for display.

netvox/r726xx.name: R726 Series & RA07 Series - Air Quality Sensors

netvox/r72615a.name: R72615A - Wireless CO2/Temperature/Humidity Sensor
netvox/r72615a.description: The Netvox R72615A has a CO2, temperature, and humidity sensor that detects and transmits CO2 level, ambient temperature, and humidity data. It uses LoRaWAN to transmit data to an application server.

netvox/r72616.name: R72616 - Wireless Outdoor PM2.5/Temperature/Humidity Sensor with Solar Panel
netvox/r72616.description: The R72616 is equipped with a temperature and humidity sensor that detects and transmits ambient temperature and humidity data. It is a wireless communication method that uses the SX1276 wireless communication module. The R72616 has a PM2.5 sensor that detects the concentration of PM2.5 in the air.

netvox/r72616a.name: R72616A - Wireless PM2.5/Temperature/Humidity Sensor
netvox/r72616a.description: R72616A with temperature and humidity sensor can detect and send the temperature and humidity data of the environment. The device is in line with the LoRa protocol standard. R72616A with PM2.5 dust sensor can be used to obtain the concentration of suspended particulates in air per unit volume.

netvox/r72632a01.name: R72632A01 - Wireless Outdoor Nitrogen/Phosphorus/Potassium Sensor with Solar Panel
netvox/r72632a01.description: The R72632A01 is equipped with a temperature and humidity sensor that detects and transmits ambient temperature and humidity data. It is a wireless communication method that uses the SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r72716.name: R72716(RA0716Y) - Wireless Outdoor PM2.5 Temperature Humidity Sensor
netvox/r72716.description: RA0716Y carrying temperature and humidity sensors that can detect and send the environment temperature and humidity data with wireless communication, compatible with LoRaWAN™ protocol standards. R72716 carrying PM2.5 dust sensor which can obtain the concentration of suspended particulate matter in the air per unit volume.

netvox/r730ck2.name: R730CK2 - Wireless 2-Gang Thermocouple Interface - K type
netvox/r730ck2.description: This equipment is used to detect temperature of the object and medium which thermocouple is contacted. It can be connected to two thermocouples for testing.

netvox/r730ct2.name: R730CT2 - Wireless 2-Gang Thermocouple Interface - T type
netvox/r730ct2.description: This equipment is used to detect temperature of the object and medium which thermocouple is contacted. It can be connected to two thermocouples for testing. It uses SX1276 wireless communication module.

netvox/r809a.name: R809A - Wireless Power Plug with Power Meter
netvox/r809a.description: R809A is a Wireless Plug-and-Play Power Outlet with Consumption Monitoring for indoor use. It can remotely control the output switch and detect the output power. It integrates the LoRa/FSK modulation communication wireless module SX1276 which can realize wireless remote control. R809A has a 10A/230VAC output load capability and is primarily used to measure electrical power consumption and wireless switch control.

netvox/r816b.name: R816B - Wireless US Type Wall Socket with Power Meter
netvox/r816b.description: R816B (wireless wall socket with energy consumption monitoring (US)) is a smart electrical switch socket for indoor use. It is suitable for US standard wall cassette installation. The output socket is suitable for US standard 2 or 3 pole plug; rated output load is 15A/120V. R816B integrates LoRa/FSK modulation communication wireless module SX1276, which can realize wireless remote control. It can control the single-channel power output to be turned on and off through internal relay, and can detect the current, voltage, power, and electrical energy of the device connected to it. (The output of the upper socket is uncontrolled, the output of the lower socket is the relay control output, and the output power detection function is provided. There is a relay control button and two LED indicators between the two sockets.)

netvox/r831d.name: R831D - Wireless Multifunctional Control Box
netvox/r831d.description: R831D have three relay switches(output) and three dry contacts(input). R831D can report status of 3 dry contacts individually and control 3 relays

netvox/r900a01.name: R900A01 - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r900a01.description: The Netvox R900A01 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r900a01o1.name: R900A01O1 - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r900a01o1.description: The Netvox R900A01O1 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r900a02.name: R900A02 - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r900a02.description: The Netvox R900A02 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r900a02o1.name: R900A02O1 - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r900a02o1.description: The Netvox R900A02O1 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r900a03.name: R900A03 - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r900a03.description: The Netvox R900A03 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r900a03o1.name: R900A03O1 - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r900a03o1.description: The Netvox R900A03O1 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r900pb03o1.description: The Netvox R900PB03O1 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.
