netvox/r900pd01.description: The Netvox R900PD01 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/r900pd01o1.name: R900PD01O1 - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/r900pd01o1.description: The Netvox R900PD01O1 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/ra02a.name: RA02A - Wireless Smoke Detector
netvox/ra02a.description: RA02A is a high reliability wireless control alarm device that detects the concentration of smoke in the air and sends a warning tone. It is a wireless communication method and complies with the LoRaWAN™ protocol standard.

netvox/ra02c.name: RA02C - Wireless CO Detector
netvox/ra02c.description: RA02C is a wireless control alarm device for smart home and high reliability. It adopts wireless communication method conforming to the LoRaWAN protocol standard. RA02C is a device for the detection of harmful gases in the home environment. It is suitable for the detection of CO (carbon monoxide). When the concentration exceeds the preset value, it will trigger the alarm and fully comply with the LoRaWAN protocol standard.

netvox/ra02d1.name: RA02D1 - Wireless Water leak Sensor
netvox/ra02d1.description: The Netvox RA02D1 Water Leak Detector comes with two water leak sensors suitable for detecting water and other liquid leaks in residential and commercial buildings. When the sensor detects a leak, an alarm message will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network.

netvox/ra02g.name: RA02G - Wireless Smoking Warning
netvox/ra02g.description: RA02G is a Wireless Smoking Warning.

netvox/ra07w.name: RA07W - Wireless Water Leak Detection and Location Sensor
netvox/ra07w.description: RA07W is a water leak detector leak locating equipment, which can be connected to water leak sensor through the external four-core positioning leak detection sensor line to detect the water leak location, and transmit the detected data to other devices through the wireless network.

netvox/ra0715.name: RA0715 - Wireless CO2/Temperature/Humidity Sensor
netvox/ra0715.description: The Netvox RA0715-Wireless CO2/Temperature/Humidity Sensor for measuring temperature and humidity. It also has a built-in PM2.5 sensor for measuring CO2 concentration in the air to ensure air quality.

netvox/ra0715y.name: RA0715Y - Wireless Outdoor CO2/Temperature/Humidity Sensor
netvox/ra0715y.description: The Netvox RA0715Y is an outdoor environmental sensor that consists of CO2, temperature, and humidity sensors. It is compatible with LoRaWAN® protocol (Class A).

netvox/ra0716.name: RA0716 - Wireless PM2.5/Temperature/Humidity Sensor
netvox/ra0716.description: RA0716 is equipped with the external temperature and humidity sensor which can detect and send the data of the ambient temperature and humidity.It adopts the wireless communication method and conforms to the LoRa protocol standard. RA0716 is equipped with the PM2.5 dust sensor which can be used to detect the concentration of suspended particles in the air per unit volume.

netvox/ra10.name: RA10 - Wireless LoRa Valve keeper
netvox/ra10.description: The valve disconnector RA10 is a wireless smart device for home security and automatic irrigation. It uses SX1276 wireless communication. Join RA10 to the gateway and realizes the operation of automatically opening and closing the valve through the instructions of other devices in the network. It can also use the manual switch function.

netvox/rb02b.name: RB02B - Wireless 2-Gang Push Button
netvox/rb02b.description: RB02B is a high-reliability wireless controlling terminal device. It has the characteristics of low power consumption during the standby status, and applying the SX1276 wireless communication module. RB02B is a long-distance smart wall switch which is a Class A device of netvox based on the LoRaWAN open protocol. According to the needs of different applications, press the trigger button of RB02B. The device immediately sends trigger information to the gateway.

netvox/rb02c.name: RB02C - Wireless 3-Gang Push Button
netvox/rb02c.description: RB02C is a high-reliability wireless controlling terminal device for smart homes. It has the characteristics of standby, low power consumption, and applying the SX1276 wireless communication module. RB02C has three buttons which can control three switch devices.

netvox/rb02i.name: RB02I - Wireless Emergency Push Button
netvox/rb02i.description: The Netvox RB02I is a wireless control terminal device that consists of a large push-button for emergency alarm triggering. It features low standby power consumption and is fully compliant with the LoRaWAN® protocol.

netvox/rb11e.name: RB11E - Wireless Occupancy/Temperature/Light Sensor
netvox/rb11e.description: The Netvox RB11E is a Wireless Occupancy/Light/Temperature Sensor that combines occupancy, temperature, tamper switch, and light sensors that are suitable for detecting human movement indoors, illuminance, and temperature. It will send data to a LoRaWAN® network for further processing.

netvox/rp02.name: RP02 - Wireless Bottom-installed Ultrasonic Liquid Level Sensor
netvox/rp02.description: The RP02 is a wireless communication device that measures the liquid level with an ultrasonic liquid level sensor. Ultrasonic liquid level sensor installed at the bottom of the container, it may measure water, gasoline, diesel and small, medium, large capacity storage tanks (metal, plastic, glass material). RP0222 main unit and the ultrasonic liquid level sensor communicate via RS485 interface, and the detected data is sent to the other equipment shown which employs compliance LoraWANTM wireless communication protocol standards.

nexelec/track.name: track
nexelec/track.description: The TRACK+ outdoor air quality monitoring station is connected via LoRaWAN or 4G LTE, powered by battery, mains, DC voltage or solar energy, and configurable via NFC. The station incorporates sensors to measure fine particles, temperature, humidity, atmospheric pressure, and offers automatic geolocation via GPS. It is designe for outdoor use with simplified maintenance.

nexelec/carbon.name: Carbon - Air Quality
nexelec/carbon.description: Carbon measures the CO2 level and continuously monitors air quality to visually alert occupants when it is time to ventilate to renew indoor air. With its temperature and humidity sensors, Carbon also analyzes the ambient parameters of the building. Carbon integrates the iZiAiR air quality and hygrothermal comfort algorithm to easily study each indoor environment and identify possible improvements. Thanks to its wireless communication module, data can be accessed remotely, simply from a smartphone or a computer screen

nexelec/sign.name: SIGN - Air Quality, VOC, Light, Movement, Sound
nexelec/sign.description: SIGN is a 7-in-1 LoRaWAN-connected, battery- or USB-powered room sensor that can be rapidly configurable via NFC. Depending on the model, the sensor can measure temperature, humidity, CO2, VOCs, brightness, presence and noise.

nexelec/move.name: MOVE - Air Quality, Light, Motion
nexelec/move.description: MOVE is a 5-in-1 LoRaWAN-connected, battery- or USB-powered room sensor that can be rapidly configurable via NFC. Depending on the model, the sensor can measure temperature, humidity, brightness, presence and noise.

nexelec/rise.name: RISE - Air Quality
nexelec/rise.description: RISE is a 3-in-1 LoRaWAN-connected, battery- or USB-powered room sensor that can be rapidly configurable via NFC. Depending on the model, the sensor can measure co2, temperature and humidity.

nexelec/feel.name: FEEL - Temperature & Humidity Sensor
nexelec/feel.description: FEEL is a 2-in-1 LoRaWAN-connected, battery- or USB-powered room sensor that can be rapidly configurable via NFC. Depending on the model, the sensor can measure temperature and humidity.

nexelec/origin-plus.name: ORIGIN PLUS
nexelec/origin-plus.description: Origin+ is an LoRaWAN-connected, interconnected, NFC-configurable smoke detector. The product incorporates a temperature and humidity sensor and is powered by sealed batteries.

nexelec/origin.name: ORIGIN
nexelec/origin.description: Origin is an LoRaWAN-connected, interconnected, NFC-configurable smoke detector. The product is powered by sealed batteries.

nexelec/guard-plus.name: GUARD PLUS
nexelec/guard-plus.description: Guard+ is an LoRaWAN-connected, interconnected, NFC-configurable smoke detector. The product incorporates a temperature and humidity sensor and is powered by replaceable battery.

nexelec/guard.name: GUARD
nexelec/guard.description: Guard is an LoRaWAN-connected, interconnected, NFC-configurable smoke detector. The product is powered by replaceable battery.

nke-watteco/th-sensor.name: TH - Temperature & Humidity Sensor
nke-watteco/th-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO TH sensor measures indoor ambient temperature and humidity in buildings, apartments, and houses. It transmits data over a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

nke-watteco/t-indoor-sensor.name: Temperature Indoor Sensor
nke-watteco/t-indoor-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO temperature indoor sensor measures indoor ambient temperature and transmits data over the LoRaWAN® network.

nke-watteco/t-2-ctn-sensor.name: Remote Temperature 2 CTN
nke-watteco/t-2-ctn-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Remote Temperature 2 CTN allows connecting 2 temperature sensor probes for measuring temperature in buildings and transmits the data over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

nke-watteco/pulse-senso-sensor.name: Pulse Sens'O - Smart Meter Interface
nke-watteco/pulse-senso-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Pulse Sens’O consists of a pulse sensor (counter) for remotely reading metering data from three meters - water, gas, electricity, or energy. It turns existing meters into smart meters via a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

nke-watteco/presso-sensor.name: Press'O - Analog Interface
nke-watteco/presso-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Press'O sensor turns any 0-10V, 4-20mA analog gauge into a Class A sensor connected to a public or private LoRaWAN® network that allows the monitoring, measurement, and remote reading of any fluid level (water, oil, gas, etc).

nke-watteco/vaqao-sensor.name: Vaqa'O - Temp/Hum/VOC/CO2 SensorTemp/Hum/VOC/CO2 Sensor
nke-watteco/vaqao-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Vaqa’O sensor is a LoRaWAN® device that measures the temperature, relative humidity, concentration of volatile organic compounds (VOC), and carbon dioxide (CO2) in the ambient air of a room, in a building, an apartment, or a house. It allows Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) monitoring.

nke-watteco/vaqao-plus-sensor.name: Vaqa'O+Plus - Temp/Hum/VOC/CO2/Motion Sensor
nke-watteco/vaqao-plus-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Vaqa’O+ has sensors for measuring temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric pressure, the concentration of volatile organic compounds (VOC), and carbon dioxide (CO2) in the ambient air of a room in a building, an apartment, or a house. It allows Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) monitoring based on the presence of individuals using luminosity (lighting) and motion (PIR) detection in the room. The data is transmitted via a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

nke-watteco/remote-t-sensor.name: Remote temperature sensor
nke-watteco/remote-t-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Remote temperature sensor is dedicated to connecting a temperature sensor probe for measuring temperature in buildings, temperature-controlled rooms, cooling towers. It transmits the data over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

nke-watteco/ino-sensor.name: In'O - I/O Interface
nke-watteco/ino-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO In’O includes optocoupled 10 inputs and 4 outputs. It turns any type of I/O sensor/actuator into a Class A or Class C sensor/actuator and connects to a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

nke-watteco/smart-plug.name: Smart Plug
nke-watteco/smart-plug.description: The nke WATTECO Smart Plug sensor supports remotely manage the operation and consumption of common household electrical appliances such as lamps, televisions, and heating equipment.

nke-watteco/atmo-sensor.name: Atm'O - Temperature/Humidity/Atmospheric Pressure
nke-watteco/atmo-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Atm’O has sensors for measuring temperature, relative humidity, and atmospheric pressure in outdoors and industrial environments, and transmits the data over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

nke-watteco/celso-sensor.name: Cels'O - Temperature Sensor
nke-watteco/celso-sensor.description: The Cels’O sensor measures the ambient temperature as well as the temperature of sensitive products in order to control and observe cold chain integrity in the agri-food and transport sectors

nke-watteco/humido-sensor.name: Humid'O - Liquid Sensor Probe
nke-watteco/humido-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO LoRaWAN® Humid’O Sensor has a liquid sensor probe for detecting water in places like boiler rooms, computer rooms, or data centres.

nke-watteco/intenso-sensor.name: Intens'O - Current Meter
nke-watteco/intenso-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Intens’O sensor measures the intensity of electric current using its clamp-on ammeter and determines the state of the equipment based on a selectable current threshold. The data is then transmitted over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

nke-watteco/levo-plus-sensor.name: Lev'O+ - Pressure Sensor Probe
nke-watteco/levo-plus-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO LoRaWAN®  Lev’O+ has a pressure sensor probe for measuring liquid (water, fuel, oil, fertilizer, etc) levels in tanks.

nke-watteco/pulse-senso-atex-zone-1-sens.name: Pulse Sens'O AtEx Zone 1 - Smart Meter Interface
nke-watteco/pulse-senso-atex-zone-1-sens.description: The nke WATTECO LoRaWAN® Pulse Sens'O AtEx Zone 1 has a pulse sensor for reading meter data from water, gas (such as Itron, Esther, and Gazpar), or electricity in AtEx zone 1 sensitive areas. It also includes digital input and voltage sensors.

nke-watteco/skydome-sensor.name: Skydome - Window Position Sensor
nke-watteco/skydome-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Skydome has an onboard accelerometer for detecting the change of position to verify that a roof window is properly closed.

nke-watteco/ventilo-sensor.name: Ventil'O - Pressure & Temperature Sensor
nke-watteco/ventilo-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Ventil'O has sensors for measuring pressure and temperature in vacuums established by outdoor ventilation chambers.

nke-watteco/torano-atex-zone-1-sensor.name: Toran'O AtEx Zone 1 - I/O Interface
nke-watteco/torano-atex-zone-1-sensor.description: The nke WATTECO Toran’O AtEx Zone 1 sensor is used to report status changes, pulse count values, and analog measurements of equipment in the AtEx 1 sensitive zone such as water, gas, electricity, or thermal energy meters, mechanical pressure switches, pressure transducers. It makes existing equipment communicate on a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

nke-watteco/bob-assistant.name: Bob Assistant - Vibration Sensor
nke-watteco/bob-assistant.description: BoB Assistant is a low power LoRaWAN compatible vibration sensor for indoor and outdoor predictive maintenance industrial applications, coupled with a temperature sensor for environmental conditions, a push buttonand an RGB Led for User Interface.

nke-watteco/triphaso-sensor.name: Triphas'O - Energy Consumption Interface
nke-watteco/triphaso-sensor.description: The Triphas’O sensor is used to remotely read the electrical energy consumption of a three-phase installation in a non-intrusive way via the LoRaWAN™ network. It is specially designed to meet the energy management needs of industrial and tertiary buildings that operate with medium / high power, energy intensive equipment.

noah/trashbin-sensor.name: Trashbin Sensor
noah/trashbin-sensor.description: Trashbin Sensor for Monitoring trash fill level

nwave/nps310sm.name: Smart Parking Sensor
nwave/nps310sm.description: The Nwave Smart Parking Sensor is equipped with a magnetometer, temperature, and proximity sensors for parking detection. The smart parking sensors installed in each parking spot generate data on space occupancy in real-time and is transmitted over a LoRaWAN network.

nwave/nps405sm.name: Smart Parking Sensor G4 SM
nwave/nps405sm.description: The wireless vehicle detection sensor with high detection accuracy 99.7%, fast detection 3-5 seconds, low profile - 20mm, 10 years battery life @20 parking sessions a day, vehicle counting capabilities.

nwave/nps405fm.name: Smart Parking Sensor G4 FM
nwave/nps405fm.description: The wireless vehicle detection sensor with high detection accuracy 99.7%, fast detection 3-5 seconds, low profile - 20mm, 10 years battery life @20 parking sessions a day, vehicle counting capabilities.

nwave/ncc405fm.name: Smart Car Counter G4 FM
nwave/ncc405fm.description: The wireless passing vehicle counting sensor 99.5% counting accuracy , low profile - 20mm.

nwave/ncc405sm.name: Smart Car Counter G4 SM
nwave/ncc405sm.description: The wireless passing vehicle counting sensor 99.5% counting accuracy , low profile - 20mm.

open-boat-projects/loraboatmonitor.name: LoRa Boat Monitor
open-boat-projects/loraboatmonitor.description: The LoRa boat monitor is used to monitor the boat when you are away. Various measured values such as battery voltage, GPS position, humidity, temperature, air pressure, filling levels, bilge and door contact are continuously forwarded to the LoRaWAN and recorded at freely adjustable time intervals via the LoRa radio technology.

opensource/esp32-paxcounter.name: ESP32-Paxcounter
opensource/esp32-paxcounter.description: The ESP32-Paxcounter has sensors for battery, GPS, altitude, temperature, humidity, barometer, pm2.5, and pm10. It is an ESP32 MCU-based device for metering passenger flows in real-time. It counts how many mobile devices are around by scanning WiFi and Bluetooth signals in the air and provides an estimation of how many people are around. The captured data is transmitted over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

pallidus/mr1.name: Animal Activity Sensor
pallidus/mr1.description: The MR1 Activity Sensor Wing allows mounting Panasonic WL series PIR sensors and connecting additional external sensors.

parametric/pcr2.name: PCR2 Radar People Counter
parametric/pcr2.description: Parametric‘s PCR2 people counter uses radar signals to provide a camera-less solution. Utilising LoRaWAN™ technology, these sensors transmit data at regular intervals. With bi-directional counting, the Parametric PCR2 people counter registers people passing by from left or right.

pepperl-fuchs/wilsen-sonic-level.name: WILSEN.sonic.level
pepperl-fuchs/wilsen-sonic-level.description: Wireless ultrasonic sensor with LoRaWAN interface

pepperl-fuchs/wilsen-sonic-distance.name: WILSEN.sonic.distance
pepperl-fuchs/wilsen-sonic-distance.description: Wireless ultrasonic sensor with LoRaWAN interface

pepperl-fuchs/wilsen-valve.name: WILSEN.valve
pepperl-fuchs/wilsen-valve.description: Wireless valve sensor with LoRaWAN interface

pepperl-fuchs/wilsen-node.name: WILSEN.node
pepperl-fuchs/wilsen-node.description: Wireless node sensor with LoRaWAN interface

quandify/cubicmeter-1-1-copper.name: CubicMeter 1.1 Copper
quandify/cubicmeter-1-1-copper.description: Clamp-on water flow meter and leak sensor.

quandify/cubicmeter-1-1-plastic.name: CubicMeter 1.1 Plastic
quandify/cubicmeter-1-1-plastic.description: Clamp-on water flow meter and leak sensor.

radio-bridge/rbs301-abm.name: RBS301-ABM - Movement Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs301-abm.description: The acceleration-based movement sensor uses an internal accelerometer to detect movement of an asset and is designed for internal use. Applications include asset monitoring, building security, shock sensing and movement detection.

radio-bridge/rbs301-dws.name: RBS301-DWS - Door/Window Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs301-dws.description: The door/window sensor uses a magnet to detect open/close events for doors, windows, or other applications that use a magnet to detect close proximity.

radio-bridge/rbs301-temp-ext.name: RBS301-TEMP-EXT - Indoor External Temperature Probe Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs301-temp-ext.description: This indoor temperature sensor measures temperature using an external temperature probe. Ideal for food service, cold chain monitoring, restaurants, laboratory monitoring, server rooms, and warehouses.

radio-bridge/rbs301-temp-int.name: RBS301-TEMP-INT - Probeless Temperature Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs301-temp-int.description: This sensor measures the temperature of the air surrounding the sensor without any external probes such as a thermocouple or thermistor.

radio-bridge/rbs301-tilt.name: RBS301-TILT - Low Precision Tilt Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs301-tilt.description: The indoor tilt sensor uses an accelerometer to detect transitions between horizontal and vertical orientation, as well as reporting the angle of tilt. When the sensor is rotated from horizontal to vertical or visa versa, an alert is sent to the wireless network. The thresholds for triggering a tilt event are configurable over the air. Applications include inclination monitoring, garage doors, pole lean detection, loading gates, and bay door orientation.

radio-bridge/rbs301-wat.name: RBS301-WAT - Indoor Water Detect Sensor (Probe)
radio-bridge/rbs301-wat.description: This sensor uses a probe to detect the presence of water or other liquids. When the presence of water or another liquid is detected, an alert is sent to the wireless network. Designed for indoor use.

radio-bridge/rbs301-wr1m.name: RBS01-WR1M - Indoor Water Detect Sensor (Rope)
radio-bridge/rbs301-wr1m.description: This sensor uses a water rope to detect the presence of water or other liquids. When the presence of water or another liquid is detected, an alert is sent to the wireless network. Designed for indoor use.

radio-bridge/rbs301-1.name: RBS301-1 - Single Button
radio-bridge/rbs301-1.description: The wireless sensors designed and manufactured by Radio Bridge provide full sensor to cloud solutions for Internet of Things (IoT) applications. The wireless single push button sensor can be used as a panic button, PERS, remote control, or other remote push button applications. When the button is pressed, a message is sent over the wireless network.

radio-bridge/rbs305-ath.name: RBS305-ATH - Indoor Air Temperature & Humidity Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs305-ath.description: This indoor sensor uses air flow to measure temperature and humidity levels with accuracies of +/- 0.1 °C and +/- 1.5 %RH respectively. If the temperature and/or humidity rises above or falls below the configured thresholds, an alert is sent over the wireless network.

radio-bridge/rbs306-420ma.name: RBS306-420MA - 4-20mA Current Loop Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-420ma.description: The 4-20mA Current Loop Sensor can measure the current from another device or sensor. It uses a 10-bit ADC to measure an analog value between 4 and 20mA with a 10uA resolution.  If the measured value rises above or fails below the configured thresholds, an alert is sent over the wireless network. The weather-proof enclosure makes the sensor suitable for outdoor and industrial use. The 4-20mA sensor can also be used as a bridge device to enable a wide variety of sensors with only a 4-20mA output.

radio-bridge/rbs306-abm.name: RBS306-ABM - Acceleration-based Movement Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-abm.description: The acceleration-based movement sensor uses an internal accelerometer to detect movement of an asset and is designed for outdoor/industrial use. Applications include asset monitoring, building security, shock sensing and movement detection.

radio-bridge/rbs306-ath-ext.name: RBS306-ATH-EXT - Outdoor Air Temperature & Humidity Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-ath-ext.description: The external-probe air temperature and humidity sensor uses air flow through a sintered porous stainless steel filter to allow for temperature and humidity measurements in outdoor and industrial environments. The sintered porous filter is IP54 rated to protect against dust and debris.

radio-bridge/rbs306-con.name: RBS306-CON - Dry Contact Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-con.description: This two-wire dry sensor detects a connection between two-wires. The weather-proof enclosure makes the sensor suitable for outdoor and industrial use. The contact sensor can also be used as a bridge device to enable a wide variety of sensors.

radio-bridge/rbs306-mbhr.name: RBS306-MBHR - Maxbotix Ultrasonic Distance Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-mbhr.description: The Maxbotix Ultrasonic Sensor measures distances between the sensor and objects using high-frequency sound pulses. If the distance exceeds or drops below a defined threshold, an alert is sent over the wireless network. It works with Maxbotix HR series sensors (models MB738, MB758, and MB7150). The weather-proof enclosure makes the sensor suitable for outdoor and industrial use.

radio-bridge/rbs306-temp-ext.name: RBS306-TEMP-EXT - Outdoor External Temperature Probe
radio-bridge/rbs306-temp-ext.description: The external probe outdoor/industrial temperature sensor measures temperature using an external temperature probe. Ideal for food service, cold chain monitoring, restaurants, laboratory monitoring, server rooms, and warehouses.

radio-bridge/rbs306-temp-tc.name: RBS306-TEMP-TC - Thermocouple Temperature Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-temp-tc.description: The wireless thermocouple temperature sensor measures temperature using an external K-type thermocouple. Other thermocouples may be used and can be configured via downlink messages. Multiple thermocouple types supported: B, E, J, K, N, R, S, and T. The Armored Sensor™ enclosure makes the sensor suitable for outdoor and industrial use. Applications include gas turbine exhaust, diesel engines, industrial processes, flame sensor, petroleum refineries, appliance heating, and food processing and production.

radio-bridge/rbs306-tilt-hp.name: RBS306-TILT-HP - High Precision Tilt Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-tilt-hp.description: The high-precision tilt sensor uses an accelerometer to measure angle of tilt between 0-180 degrees with precision of 0.1 degrees. Available as a weather-proof version suitable for outdoor and industrial use.

radio-bridge/rbs306-us10m.name: RBS306-US10M - Ultrasonic Level Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-us10m.description: The ultrasonic level sensor provides high accuracy ultrasonic proximity detection and ranging in air. The Outdoor/Industrial enclosure makes the sensor suitable for outdoor and industrial use.

radio-bridge/rbs306-vm30.name: RBS306-VM30 - Voltage Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-vm30.description: The wireless voltage sensor measures voltages between 0-30V with 10mV precision. When the voltage rises above or drops below a threshold, an alert is sent over the wireless network. An indoor/smart building version is also available for low cost applications. There are also current sensor attachments that can be added to the voltage sensor to measure AC current from a range of 0-5A up to a range of 0-300A.

radio-bridge/rbs306-vshb.name: RBS306-VSHB - Vibration Sensor
radio-bridge/rbs306-vshb.description: The vibration analysis and condition monitoring sensor solution provides advanced predictive maintenance capabilities for rotating machines and other equipment. The vibration sensor can be used for simple motor on/off functionality, or vibration analysis utilizing ISO standards such as ISO 10816.  The high frequencies are used for more advanced analysis not specified in ISO standards.  Applications include heavy machinery performance, motor performance, and bearing failure just to name a few.

radio-bridge/rbs306-wr1m.name: RBS306-WR1M - Outdoor Water Detect Sensor (Rope)
radio-bridge/rbs306-wr1m.description: This sensor uses a water rope to detect the presence of water or other liquids. When the presence of water or another liquid is detected, an alert is sent to the wireless network. Designed for industrial/outdoor use.

radionode/rn320bth.name: RN320-BTH
radionode/rn320bth.description: LoRaWAN based Temperature & Humidity Data Logger

restotracker/scd18.name: SCD18 - Tracker
restotracker/scd18.description: Ultra-low power consumption, indoor&outdoor(BLE&WIFI&GPS) LoRaWAN Tracker

rivercity-innovations/txh.name: TxH - Temperature & Humidity Sensor
rivercity-innovations/txh.description: This LoRaWAN sensor can be used for monitoring temperature and/or humidity in both indoor or outdoor environments. Sensor has two magnets on the back which allows it to be mounted easily onto metal surfaces.

rivercity-innovations/lynx.name: Lynx - Micro LoRa GPS Tracker
rivercity-innovations/lynx.description: The Lynx is a micro LoRa GPS tracker meant for use on small assets such as bikes and pets. Charging is made easy with a built in micro-usb charging port and an LED status indicator. Product of BeeSecure by Rivercity Innovations Ltd.

sensedge/senstick-pro.name: Senstick Pro - Microclimate Sensor
sensedge/senstick-pro.description: The Sensedge Senstick Pro is an industrial-grade LoRaWAN® microclimate sensor for use with indoor or outdoor harsh environments that features temperature, humidity, pressure, and movement sensors. Suitable for applications such as monitoring temperature in medical refrigerators, improving thermal comfort for workers, reducing overheating of machines in manufacturing, monitoring temperature and humidity of raw materials, etc.

sensedge/senstick-pure.name: Senstick Pure - Air Quality & Microclimate Sensor
sensedge/senstick-pure.description: The Sensedge Senstick Pure is an indoor LoRaWAN® air quality and microclimate sensor that features IAQ, temperature, humidity, and pressure sensors. Suitable for monitoring air quality in personal and public spaces. The device sends data to the LoRaWAN® network and notifies users to open the windows if the air quality is poor.

senzemo/smc30.name: SMC30 - Senstick Microclimate
senzemo/smc30.description: The Senzemo Senstick Microclimate is an industrial-grade LoRaWAN® microclimate sensor for use with indoor or outdoor harsh environments that features temperature, humidity, pressure, and movement sensors. Suitable for applications such as monitoring temperature in medical refrigerators, improving thermal comfort for workers, reducing overheating of machines in manufacturing, monitoring temperature and relative humidity of air.

senzemo/spu20.name: SPU20 - Senspuck Pure PV
senzemo/spu20.description: The Senzemo Senpuck Pure is an indoor LoRaWAN® air quality sensor that measures CO2, TVOC, temperature, realtive humidity, and pressure. Suitable for monitoring air quality in enterprise and public spaces. The device sends data to the LoRaWAN® network and notifies users to open the windows if the air quality is poor.

senzemo/spu20b.name: SPU20B - Senspuck Pure Battery
senzemo/spu20b.description: The Senzemo Senpuck Pure is an indoor LoRaWAN® air quality sensor that measures CO2, TVOC, temperature, realtive humidity, and pressure. Suitable for monitoring air quality in enterprise and public spaces. The device sends data to the LoRaWAN® network and notifies users to open the windows if the air quality is poor.

sezo/sezocl.name: CL - Air Quality Sensor
sezo/sezocl.description: Compact low-power sensor device measuring environmental parameters

sezo/sezosl.name: SL - Air Quality Sensor
sezo/sezosl.description: Compact low-power sensor device measuring environmental parameters

slscorp/volc2180.name: VOLC2180
slscorp/volc2180.description: Lora-based Outdoor Street light controller, Suitable for Smart Street Light applications such as monitoring, controlling, alarms notification, Smart City, Smart Lighting, and suitable for Pole mount.

smart-parks/opencollar.name: OpenCollar - Wildlife Protection
smart-parks/opencollar.description: First generation of OpenCollar devices. A collection of advanced devices designed for wildlife protection.

smartrural/grain-probe-01.name: Grain Probe
smartrural/grain-probe-01.description: Grain probe for use as a 0006-000002 Grain monitor

southerniot/senseclimate.name: senseclimate
southerniot/senseclimate.description: Climate Sensor with temperature and humidity

sting/pengy.name: Pengy
sting/pengy.description: Device for monitoring of the air quality parameters like air temperature and relative humidity, atmospheric pressure, environmental noise and particulate matter mass concetration.

stmicroelectronics/nucleo-wl55jc1.name: NUCLEO-WL55JC1
stmicroelectronics/nucleo-wl55jc1.description: The STMicroelectronics NUCLEO-WL55JC1 is a development board based on the STM32WL55JC microcontroller that comes with a built-in temperature sensor and a light sensor. The NUCLEO-WL55JC1 board supports a wide choice of Integrated Development Environments (IDE) and an expansion connector for Arduino UNO V3. Suitable for rapid prototyping of LoRaWAN® end nodes by adding sensors and actuators.

stmicroelectronics/nucleo-wl55jc2.name: NUCLEO-WL55JC2
stmicroelectronics/nucleo-wl55jc2.description: The STMicroelectronics NUCLEO-WL55JC2 is a development board based on the STM32WL55JC microcontroller that comes with a built-in temperature sensor and a light sensor. The NUCLEO-WL55JC2 board supports a wide choice of Integrated Development Environments (IDE) and an expansion connector for Arduino UNO V3. Suitable for rapid prototyping of LoRaWAN® end nodes by adding sensors and actuators.

stmicroelectronics/steval-astra1b.name: STEVAL-ASTRA1B
stmicroelectronics/steval-astra1b.description: The STMicroelectronics STEVAL-ASTRA1B is an Asset-Tracking development kit that embeds the STM32WB5MMG and the STM32WL55JC microcontrollers supporting short and long range connectivity. It is an ultra-low-power platform including environmental and motion sensors and the GNSS module providing outdoor positioning.

strega/smart-valve.name: Smart Valve
strega/smart-valve.description: The STREGA LoRaWAN wireless smart-valve has an embedded temperature and humidity sensor, tamper detection sensor, and wire-cut detection sensor. It also accepts external analog, digital, and leak detection sensor inputs. The valve may also be configured for full water meter reading and data transmission capabilities.

strega/smart-emitter.name: Smart Emitter
strega/smart-emitter.description: The STREGA LoRaWAN Time-controlled Emitter remotely actuates an irrigation valve. With its ultra-low-power consumption, the Smart-Emitter can trigger Open or Close operations of any irrigation valve equipped with a DC latching solenoid. Watering schedulers can be programmed directly at the zone level, avoiding the necessity to use an irrigation controller.

strega/smart-switch.name: Smart Switch
strega/smart-switch.description: The STREGA time-controlled switch for the valve actuators is a battery operated wireless switch to remote control your butterfly valves. With the ultra-low-power consumption, the smart-switch can be triggered for remote OPEN/CLOSE operations.

strega/motorized-valve.name: Wireless LoRaWAN Motorized Smart Valve
strega/motorized-valve.description: The STREGA LoRaWAN wireless motorized smart-valve has an embedded temperature and humidity sensor, tamper detection sensor, and wire-cut detection sensor. It also accepts external analog, digital, and leak detection sensor inputs. The valve may also be configured for full water meter reading and data transmission capabilities.

talkpool/oy1100.name: OY1100 LoRaWAN® temperature and humidity sensor
talkpool/oy1100.description: LoRaWAN sensor that measures temperature and humidity, with an incredible maintenance free lifetime of 10 years at a 5-minute measurement interval. Easy to use, configurable over the air and stylish in design to fit into indoor spaces.

talkpool/oy1110.name: OY1110 LoRaWAN® temperature and humidity sensor
talkpool/oy1110.description: LoRaWAN sensor that measures temperature and humidity, with an incredible maintenance free lifetime of 10 years at a 5-minute measurement interval. Easy to use, configurable over the air and stylish in design to fit into indoor spaces.

talkpool/oy1210.name: OY1210 LoRaWAN CO2 meter
talkpool/oy1210.description: LoRaWAN sensor that measures temperature, humidity and carbon dioxide, with an incredible maintenance free lifetime of 5 years at a 20-minute reporting interval. Easy to use, configurable over the air and stylish in design to fit into indoor spaces. Supports adaptive reporting functionality to detect rapid changes in CO2 levels.

talkpool/oy1320.name: OY1320 LoRaWAN Water meter AMR
talkpool/oy1320.description: LoRaWAN sensor designed to function in combination with B Meters’ mechanical water meters. Complete package measures water flow in pipes automatically. Simply mount the LoRaWAN unit on top of a B Meters’ GMDM-RFM mechanical water meter and integrate the meter into your IoT system.

talkpool/oy1700.name: OY1700 LoRaWAN Particles meter
talkpool/oy1700.description: LoRaWAN sensor that measures temperature, humidity and particles, in indoor environments. Easy to use, configurable over the air and stylish in design to fit into indoor spaces.

te-connectivity/69xx.name: 69XXN - Pressure Transducer
te-connectivity/69xx.description: The 69XXN is a high accuracy wireless transducer that allow measurement of liquid or gas pressure, even for difficult media such as contaminated water, steam, and mildly corrosive fluids.

te-connectivity/8931ex.name: 8931EX - Triaxis Vibration Sensor
te-connectivity/8931ex.description: The TE model 8931EX wireless vibration sensor combines a tri axis accelerometer, a bundled DSP (FFT peak search), a data collector, and a radio into one compact, battery operated device that measures both vibration and temperature data. It was designed for hash environment and comes with the ATEX certification.

te-connectivity/8911ex.name: 8911EX - Single-Axis Vibration Sensor
te-connectivity/8911ex.description: The TE model 8911EX wireless vibration sensor combines a single axis accelerometer, a bundled DSP (FFT peak search), a data collector, and a radio into one compact, battery operated device that measures both vibration and temperature data. It was designed for hash environment and comes with the ATEX certification.

tekzitel/tekzipark.name: TEKZIPARK
tekzitel/tekzipark.description: The TEKZITEL TEKZIPARK is a smart parking sensor that uses radar technology. It enables occupancy status updates of parking spots wirelessly to the cloud environment through a LoRaWAN® network. This helps to efficiently manage the parking spaces in real-time.

teneo-iot/co2-stoplicht.name: CO2 stoplicht
teneo-iot/co2-stoplicht.description: The Teneo IoT CO2 stoplicht is equipped with a CO2 sensor, temperature sensor, and humidity sensor that alarms by means of the traffic light function when the measured values exceed the set standards. The CO2 traffic light has digital communication via LoRaWAN® or WiFi, which makes it possible to log in all measured values and view them remotely.

teneo-iot/filling-degree-sensor.name: Filling Degree Sensor
teneo-iot/filling-degree-sensor.description: The Teneo IoT Filling Degree Sensor is a LoRaWAN® waste bin management solution that combines a fillgrade laser sensor that measures the distance to the waste and a GPS receiver to obtain the location of the waste bin. The distance data (from the sensor to the top of the waste) will be sent to the LoRaWAN® network and an online dashboard can be used to display the location of the waste bins.

teneo-iot/soil-moisture-sensor.name: Soil Moisture Sensor
teneo-iot/soil-moisture-sensor.description: The Teneo IoT Soil Moisture Sensor is a dedicated LoRa node designed for remote monitoring of the humidity of the soil; for example with young trees and / or planting.

terabee/lora-lm-xl.name: LoRa Level Monitoring XL
terabee/lora-lm-xl.description: Monitor material fill levels inside your silos and tanks using wireless, low-energy Terabee IoT devices. Our LED Time-of-Flight technology can reach up to 60m range for non-intrusive inventory management - from small to even the largest silos!

terabee/people-flow-counting-m.name: people-flow-counting-m
terabee/people-flow-counting-m.description: Compact, small and discrete people counting device for single doorways and narrow passages

terabee/people-flow-counting-l-xl.name: people-flow-counting-l-xl
terabee/people-flow-counting-l-xl.description: Compact, discrete device that improve facility efficiency with accurate people counting data

terabee/people-occupancy-counting.name: people-occupancy-counting
terabee/people-occupancy-counting.description: Compact, small and discrete people occupancy counting with accurate data to Optimize space utilization

the-things-industries/generic-node-senso.name: Generic Node (Sensor Edition)
the-things-industries/generic-node-senso.description: The Things Industries Generic Node Sensor Edition is a LoRaWAN® development board that consists of a temperature and humidity sensor and an accelerometer. These onboard sensors can be used to measure temperature, humidity, motion, free fall, and orientation. In addition to that, it provides expansion slots for connecting various sensors. It is suitable for a wide range of use cases that cover industrial, farming, facility management, and leisure.

the-things-products/the-things-node.name: The Things Node
the-things-products/the-things-node.description: The Things Node is based on the SparkFun Pro Micro - 3.3V/8MHz with added Microchip LoRaWAN® module and temperature sensor, NXP’s digital accelerometer, a light sensor, button, and RGB LED. All this is packaged in a matchbox-sized waterproof (IP54) casing with 3 AAA batteries to power it for months of usage.

thermokon/dpa-lrw.name: DPA+ LRW - Pressure & Volume Flow Sensor
thermokon/dpa-lrw.description: Differential Pressure and Volume Flow Sensor

thermokon/novos-3-lrw.name: NOVOS 3 LRW - Room Operating Unit
thermokon/novos-3-lrw.description: Indoor Multifunctional Room Sensor and Operating Unit

thermokon/thanos-evo-lrw.name: Thanos Evo LRW - Room Operating Unit
thermokon/thanos-evo-lrw.description: Full Touch Room Operating Unit for Controlling with optional wired BMS connection

tinovi/pm-io-5-sm.name: LoRaWAN Soil Moisture, Temperature | Air temperature/humidity | boosted 12v output from battery
tinovi/pm-io-5-sm.description: LoRaWAN IO module with optional Soil and Air Lux sensors and optional boosted 12v reversible polarity output for latching valves.

uradmonitor/model-a3.name: MODEL A3 - Air Quality Monitoring
uradmonitor/model-a3.description: Plug and play advanced air quality monitoring station, enclosed in an aluminium body for rugged design, it has sensors for Particulate Matter (PM2.5, PM1, PM10), Ozone, Formaldehyde, Carbon Dioxide, Volatile Organic Compounds (VOC), temperature, barometric pressure, air humidity and noise.

uradmonitor/model-industrial.name: MODEL INDUSTRIAL - Air Quality Monitoring
uradmonitor/model-industrial.description: An automated, fixed monitoring station that tracks a total of 11 important air quality parameters including Particulate Matter, Carbon Monoxide, Ozone, Sulphur Dioxide, Nitrogen Dioxide and more for the INDUSTRIAL sector. It comes in a rugged aluminum enclosure with wall mounting support

volley-boast/vobo-hl-1.name: VoBo-HL-1 - Input Endpoint
volley-boast/vobo-hl-1.description: General purpose LoRaWAN bridge certified for use in Class 1 Div 2 hazardous locations

volley-boast/vobo-tc.name: VoBo-TC - Thermocouple Endpoint
volley-boast/vobo-tc.description: The VoBo TC is an industrial grade 12 channel thermocouple LoRaWAN® bridge certified for Class 1 Division 2 hazardous areas

volley-boast/vobo-xp.name: VoBo-XP - Input Endpoint
volley-boast/vobo-xp.description: The VoBo XP is an externally powered, industrial grade, 7 input, 4 output, LoRaWAN® bridge certified for Class 1 Division 2 (pending) hazardous areas

watteco/atmo.name: Atm'O - Temperature/Humidity/Atmospheric Pressure
watteco/atmo.description: The WATTECO Atm’O has sensors for measuring temperature, relative humidity, and atmospheric pressure in outdoors and industrial environments, and transmits the data over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

watteco/bob-assistant.name: Bob Assistant - Vibration Sensor
watteco/bob-assistant.description: BoB Assistant is a low power LoRaWAN compatible vibration sensor for indoor and outdoor predictive maintenance industrial applications, coupled with a temperature sensor for environmental conditions, a push buttonand an RGB Led for User Interface.

watteco/climo.name: Clim'O - Indoor Temperature/Humidity
watteco/climo.description: The WATECO Clim'O sensor measures indoor ambient temperature and humidity in buildings, apartments, and houses. It transmits data over a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/closo.name: Clos'O - Contact Sensor
watteco/closo.description: The Clos’O sensor is used to ensure an access gate is properly closed. Attached to the frame (or the fixed part), it detects the position of a magnet mounted on the moving part of the gate. It also reports the open or closed state of the gate over a public or private LoRaWAN™ radio network. An alert is transmitted if the sensor is pulled off.

watteco/flasho.name: Flash'O - Smart Metering
watteco/flasho.description: The WATTECO LoRaWAN® Flash’O has a pulse sensor for counting the number of light pulses emitted by any type of electronic meter - water, gas, electricity, energy.

watteco/hygrotempo.name: Hygro Temp'O - Indoor Temperature/Humidity
watteco/hygrotempo.description: The WATECO Hygro Temp'O sensor measures indoor ambient temperature and humidity in buildings, apartments, and houses. It transmits data over a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/hygrotempo-remote.name: Hygro Temp'O remote - Indoor remote Temperature/Humidity
watteco/hygrotempo-remote.description: The WATECO Hygro Temp'o remote measures temperature and humidity with a remote probe (IP68/IP67). It transmits data over a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/inclino.name: Inclino - Vertical angle measurement Sensor
watteco/inclino.description: The WATTECO Inclino features an onboard accelerometer that detects changes in position. For example, it can confirm if a roof window is properly closed. Additionally, it can be configured to detect light shocks.

watteco/indoor-temperature.name: Temperature Indoor Sensor
watteco/indoor-temperature.description: The WATTECO Indoor temperature sensor measures indoor ambient temperature and transmits data over the LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/indoor-temperature-humidity.name: TH - Temperature & Humidity Indoor Sensor
watteco/indoor-temperature-humidity.description: This WATTECO sensor measures indoor ambient temperature and humidity in buildings, apartments, and houses. It transmits data over a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/ino.name: In'O - I/O Interface
watteco/ino.description: The WATTECO In’O includes optocoupled 10 inputs and 4 outputs. It turns any type of I/O sensor/actuator into a Class A or Class C sensor/actuator and connects to a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/intenso.name: Intens'O - Current Meter
watteco/intenso.description: The WATTECO Intens’O sensor measures the intensity of electric current using its clamp-on ammeter and determines the state of the equipment based on a selectable current threshold. The data is then transmitted over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

watteco/levo.name: Lev'O+ - Pressure Sensor Probe
watteco/levo.description: The WATTECO LoRaWAN®  Lev’O+ has a pressure sensor probe for measuring liquid (water, fuel, oil, fertilizer, etc) levels in tanks. An ATEX specific probe is available separately.

watteco/monito.name: Monit'O - Analog Interface
watteco/monito.description: The WATTECO Monit'O offers 2 analog inputs isolated from each other allowing the measurement of voltage, 0-100mVolts and 0-70Volts. The measurements are transmitted periodically on the LoRaWAN® network. Monit'O is often used for battery monitoring.

watteco/moveo.name: Move'O - Temperature, Humidity, Occupancy & Luminosity Sensor
watteco/moveo.description: The Watteco MOVE’O has 4 sensors. Passive infrared (PIR), temperature T°C, humidity Hr% and luminosity. The data is transmitted via a public or private LoRaWAN® radio frequency network.

watteco/moveo-lite.name: Move'O Lite - Temperature, Humidity, Occupancy & Luminosity Sensor
watteco/moveo-lite.description: The Watteco MOVE'O Lite has 4 sensors. Passive infrared (PIR), temperature T°C, humidity Hr% and luminosity. The data is transmitted via a public or private LoRaWAN® radio frequency network.

watteco/presso.name: Press'O - Analog Interface
watteco/presso.description: The WATTECO Press'O sensor turns any 0-10V, 4-20mA analog gauge into a Class A sensor connected to a public or private LoRaWAN® network that allows the monitoring, measurement, and remote reading of any fluid level (water, oil, gas, etc).

watteco/pulse-senso.name: Pulse Sens'O - Smart Meter Interface
watteco/pulse-senso.description: The WATTECO Pulse Sens’O consists of a pulse sensor (counter) for remotely reading metering data from three meters - water, gas, electricity, or energy. It turns existing meters into smart meters via a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/pulse-senso-atex.name: Pulse Sens'O AtEx Zone 1 - Smart Meter Interface
watteco/pulse-senso-atex.description: The WATTECO LoRaWAN® Pulse Sens'O AtEx Zone 1 has a pulse sensor for reading meter data from water, gas (such as Itron, Esther, and Gazpar), or electricity in AtEx zone 1 sensitive areas. It also includes digital input and voltage sensors.

watteco/smartplug.name: Smart Plug
watteco/smartplug.description: The WATTECO Smart Plug sensor supports remotely manage the operation and consumption of common household electrical appliances such as lamps, televisions, and heating equipment.

watteco/tempo.name: Temp'O - Indoor Temperature
watteco/tempo.description: The WATECO Temp'O sensor measures indoor ambient temperature in buildings, apartments, and houses. It transmits data over a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/tempo-outdoor.name: Temp'O - Outdoor temperature sensor
watteco/tempo-outdoor.description: The WATTECO Temp'O outdoor Temperature sensor measures the outside temperature of buildings and the inside temperature of cold rooms, and transmits the data over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

watteco/tempo-remote-1-probe.name: Temp'O remote 1 probe sensor
watteco/tempo-remote-1-probe.description: The WATTECO Remote temperature sensor is dedicated to connecting a temperature sensor probe for measuring temperature in buildings, temperature-controlled rooms, cooling towers. It transmits the data over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

watteco/tempo-remote-2-probes.name: Temp'O remote 2 probes sensor
watteco/tempo-remote-2-probes.description: The WATTECO Remote Temperature 2 CTN allows connecting 2 temperature sensor probes for measuring temperature in buildings and transmits the data over a public or private LoRaWAN® radio network.

watteco/ticso.name: Tics'O -
watteco/ticso.description: Le capteur TICS’O permet le transfert de données issues de la sortie TIC des compteurs électriques électroniques d’ENEDIS vers un serveur distant en utilisant le protocole de communication LoRaWAN®. Le capteur TICS’O transforme le compteur ENEDIS en un objet connecté à Internet (IoT).

watteco/torano-atex.name: Toran'O AtEx Zone 1 - I/O Interface
watteco/torano-atex.description: The WATTECO Toran’O AtEx Zone 1 sensor is used to report status changes, pulse count values, and analog measurements of equipment in the AtEx 1 sensitive zone such as water, gas, electricity, or thermal energy meters, mechanical pressure switches, pressure transducers. It makes existing equipment communicate on a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/triphaso.name: Triphas'O - Energy Consumption Interface
watteco/triphaso.description: The Triphas’O sensor is used to remotely read the electrical energy consumption of a three-phase installation in a non-intrusive way via the LoRaWAN™ network. It is specially designed to meet the energy management needs of industrial and tertiary buildings that operate with medium / high power, energy intensive equipment.

watteco/vaqao.name: Vaqa'O - Temp/Hum/VOC/CO2 Sensor
watteco/vaqao.description: The WATTECO Vaqa’O sensor is a LoRaWAN® device that measures the temperature, relative humidity, and carbon dioxide (CO2) in the ambient air of a room, in a building, an apartment, or a house. It allows Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) monitoring.

watteco/vaqao-lite.name: Vaqa'O Lite - Temp/Hum/CO2 Sensor
watteco/vaqao-lite.description: The WATTECO Vaqa’O Lite sensor is a LoRaWAN® device that measures the temperature, relative humidity, and carbon dioxide (CO2) in the ambient air of a room, in a building, an apartment, or a house. It allows Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) monitoring.

watteco/vaqao-multi-lite.name: Vaqa'O Multi Lite - Temperature, Humidity, Luminosity, Atmospheric Pressure, IAQ, CO2 & motion sensor
watteco/vaqao-multi-lite.description: The Watteco VAQA’O Multi Lite is a LoRaWAN® device that measures Temp/Hum/AtmP/IAQ/CO2/Lum/Motion Sensor in the ambient air of a room, in a building, an apartment, or a house. The data is transmitted via a public or private LoRaWAN® radio frequency network.

watteco/vaqao-plus.name: Vaqa'O+Plus - Temp/Hum/VOC/IAQ/CO2/Motion Sensor
watteco/vaqao-plus.description: The WATTECO Vaqa’O+ has sensors for measuring temperature, relative humidity, atmospheric pressure, IAQ based on concentration of volatile organic compounds (VOC), and carbon dioxide (CO2) in the ambient air of a room in a building, an apartment, or a house. It allows Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) monitoring based on the presence of individuals using luminosity (lighting) and motion (PIR) detection in the room. The data is transmitted via a public or private LoRaWAN® network.

watteco/vaqao-plus-lite.name: Vaqa'O Multi Lite - Temperature, Humidity, Luminosity, CO2 & motion sensor
watteco/vaqao-plus-lite.description: The Watteco VAQA’O Multi Lite is a LoRaWAN® device that measures Temp/Hum/CO2/Lum/Motion Sensor in the ambient air of a room, in a building, an apartment, or a house. The data is transmitted via a public or private LoRaWAN® radio frequency network.

watteco/ventilo.name: Ventil'O - Pressure & Temperature Sensor
watteco/ventilo.description: The WATTECO Ventil'O has sensors for measuring pressure and temperature in vacuums established by outdoor ventilation chambers.

yobiiq/em2101.name: EM2101 - 1 Phase Energy Meter
yobiiq/em2101.description: The YOBIIQ iQ Electricity EM2101 is a direct connected 1 Phase Energy Meter with built-in relay for controlling output.

yobiiq/em4301.name: EM4301 - 3 Phase Energy Meter
yobiiq/em4301.description: The YOBIIQ iQ Electricity EM4301 is a direct connected, 3 Phase Energy Meter for loads up to 100A.

yobiiq/em4301-ct.name: EM4301-CT - 3 Phase Energy Meter
yobiiq/em4301-ct.description: The YOBIIQ iQ Electricity EM4301-CT is a current transformer operated, 3 Phase Energy Meter.

yobiiq/iq-rm200-lrw.name: RM200 - Digital Output Relay Module
yobiiq/iq-rm200-lrw.description: The YOBIIQ RM200 makes it possible to control digital outputs by utilizing remote automation, We have developed the iQ Digital Controller with 2 fully isolated, seperate relays. Each relay is capable of switching up to a 10A 230V AC. Using the override buttons on the device you are able to control the relay output regardless of the network connection.

yobiiq/iq-dsmr-lrw.name: iQ DSMR - Dutch Smart Meter Reader
yobiiq/iq-dsmr-lrw.description: The YOBIIQ iQ DSMR (P1) is a member of our Smart Environment Modules family and Smart metering device, DSMR Relay port, a secondary port is available to forward the DSMR signals to third party devices like solar converters or curtailment node. It contains 2 digital inputs for pulse readers from other energy sources and a optional digital output to control based on consumption.
